_about: One hand-written sentence per album (owner standard, 2026-09-16): bestseller marketing copy about what the listener gains. Never a song count, the artist name, a genre list, or "opening with". Read by lib/albumDescriptions.ts. Written from each album lyrics/blueprint on J:.

descriptions.AMIM1001EN: Pour the qahwa, light the fanous and let your first thought of the day rise straight to Jesus like incense.
descriptions.AMIM1001HI: Carry your whole story to Jesus in Hindi song and watch it rise like incense at dawn, glory upon glory.
descriptions.AMIM1002EN: Up on the ridge where Jesus passes, the whole grove bursts into song, and your heart won't stay quiet either.
descriptions.AMIM1003EN: Before the bread, before the noise, give God your first word and watch the whole day settle into peace.
descriptions.AMIM1004EN: Every wrong turn still points toward Him: take one step back to Jesus and feel Him close the rest of the distance.
descriptions.AMIM1004ID: Aku pulang, I'm coming home: hear Jesus call your name across the far country and find arms that never stopped waiting.
descriptions.AMIM1005EN: In the driest ravine of your life, discover you are the one bloom God crossed a burning silence to grow.
descriptions.AMIM1006EN: Set your suitcase down in a strange new city and find the flat was never empty: Jesus got there first.
descriptions.AMIM1007EN: Pull up a chair where many hands share one loaf, and taste the belonging of a family Jesus feeds Himself.
descriptions.AMIM1008EN: Walk through the door and hear heaven already singing your name, the whole house turning like sunflowers to welcome you.
descriptions.AMIM1008TR: Ring, robe, fattened calf: retrace the prodigal's road in Turkish song and feel a Father's embrace say you belong.
descriptions.AMIM1009EN: Dance beside a river pouring from God's throne into the driest valley, carrying the poor home on currents of grace.
descriptions.AMIM1010EN: Learn to read every kindness as a syllable and every morning as a letter Jesus slid under your door.
descriptions.AMIM1011AR: Let the oud speak His name in Arabic and bring every tear to the feet of the wounded King who wants the whole heart.
descriptions.AMIM1011EN: Hand your heart to the One who wrote its melody before its first beat, and let Him tune it string by string until it sings.
descriptions.AMIM1012EN: Slip off your sandals: the Fire that burned in Moses' bush still blazes near, and nothing green in you gets consumed.
descriptions.AMIM1012HI: Like a deer at a dried-up stream, bring your deepest thirst to Jesus in Hindi worship and drink from a spring that never fails.
descriptions.AMIM1013EN: Whatever blocks your road tomorrow, your Shepherd is already camped there with mercy warming on the fire.
descriptions.AMIM1014EN: Hear Micah's map and Amos's thunder bend toward one Name, and watch the whole Old Testament light up with Jesus.
descriptions.AMIM1015EN: When the neighbours lean over the courtyard wall asking what changed you, here is the joyful answer: Jesus.
descriptions.AMIM1016EN: Bring the years that came unravelled and let Jesus mend your torn net knot by knot, ready again by dawn.
descriptions.AMIM1016TR: Honey, olive oil and a loaf torn open with room for everyone: pull up to a Turkish table where Jesus is the host.
descriptions.AMIM1017EN: Tuck in close enough to hear God's heartbeat through the feathers, where whatever circles overhead finds nothing to take.
descriptions.AMIM1018EN: From Genesis humming the downbeat to Revelation ringing it out, discover the whole Bible carries one melody: Jesus.
descriptions.AMIM1019EN: That restless ache inside you is a compass, and it has been pointing north to Jesus all along.
descriptions.AMIM1020EN: Set an extra chair at the breakfast table, gather before the day scatters you, and feel Jesus take His seat.
descriptions.AMIM1021EN: Link arms, stamp your feet and leap like David before the ark: joy in Jesus was never meant to sit still.
descriptions.AMIM1022EN: Unclench your fists, lay down the stories you tell yourself, and find the freedom of standing in God's truth.
descriptions.AMIM1022ID: Bread, honey, an open door, the oud and the ney: offer Jesus everything you own in Indonesian song and feel lighter.
descriptions.AMIM1023EN: Break the bread and pass it hand to hand down a lantern-lit table until everyone holds what began in Jesus' hands.
descriptions.AMIM1024EN: Weigh every gold chain and crown in the bazaar against Jesus and watch the scales swing: nothing outweighs Him.
descriptions.AMIM1025EN: Even when your prayers run dry mid-sentence, God stays on the line and never, ever hangs up on you.
descriptions.AMIM1026EN: On a dusty road Jesus turns and asks the question every heart must answer: who do you say I am?
descriptions.AMIM1027EN: Climb Habakkuk's rampart with your hardest how-long prayer and hear God promise His answer will not miss its date.
descriptions.AMIM1028EN: Between the ditch of shouting and the ditch of hiding runs a narrow road, and Jesus walks you straight through the gate.
descriptions.AMIM1029EN: Long before your first breath, love was already folded around your name, and you never once had to earn it.
descriptions.AMIM1030EN: Every road you dug for water was leading here: let your bucket down and feel the deep rise up to meet you.
descriptions.AMIM1030HI: Kuan tu hi hai, the well is You: set down every thirst you've carried and drink deeply from Jesus in Hindi song.
descriptions.AMIM1031EN: One lantern at your door, then the alley, then the rooftops: watch the light God gave you spread without growing dimmer.
descriptions.AMIM1032EN: Glad as a wedding and sober as a judge: ask the Comforter to pour until your joy runs over with a crystal-clear mind.
descriptions.AMIM1033EN: Sadiqi, my friend: walk every mile with a Jesus who calls you friend and opens the Father's heart all the way to the end.
descriptions.AMIM1034EN: If you traded the Father's house for the wind and came up empty, the road back is shorter than you think, and He is running.
descriptions.AMIM1034RO: Rehearse your apology all the way home, then let the Father's embrace, the robe and the ring interrupt it in Romanian song.
descriptions.AMIM1035AR: Al-Ism Fawqa Kulli Ism: bow in Arabic before the Name that saves, stills the storm and never changes.
descriptions.AMIM1035EN: Everything standing leans on one carved keystone: rest your whole weight on the Name the Father set highest.
descriptions.AMIM1036EN: Open your eyes to mercy already waiting on the windowsill, fresh, never warmed over, up before the sun.
descriptions.AMIM1036RO: Keep watch through the long night hours in Romanian worship and greet a faithfulness the dark could never hold back.
descriptions.AMIM1037EN: Turn toward Jesus and feel the veil simply let go, until your eyes can finally breathe in unhidden glory.
descriptions.AMIM1038EN: The fig, the shade, the second wind, the sweetness after sorrow: stay rooted in Jesus and watch life turn green again.
descriptions.AMIM1039EN: After the longest silence of your life, give Jesus the first note from a dry, waking throat and hear the dawn answer.
descriptions.AMIM1040EN: Ahlan, ahlan: arrive with nothing but road dust and find Jesus at the threshold with the whole household running out.
descriptions.AMIM1040HI: Abba daude aaye: from the lowest fall to a dancing courtyard, feel the Father run to meet you before you finish saying sorry.
descriptions.AMIM1041EN: Let the siege grow old and toothless outside: you live inside stone that is still brand new, and its name is Jesus.
descriptions.AMIM1042EN: Grief can only rent the night, it cannot buy one hour of your morning; stay close to Jesus till the light breaks.
descriptions.AMIM1043EN: Turn down every almost that glitters in your palm, and hold out for the one treasure worth everything you own.
descriptions.AMIM1044EN: Open your lungs like a door and breathe in the Ruh of the living God, the breath you were shaped to live on.
descriptions.AMIM1045EN: Signed in heaven and sealed on a hill, God's 'I will' holds you steady when your own promises start to slip.
descriptions.AMIM1046EN: Your empty miles are not the end: God sends the rain, and the wilderness you gave up on starts to sing.
descriptions.AMIM1047EN: Take your post on the city wall and keep watch in prayer through the dark, eyes fixed on the face of Jesus.
descriptions.AMIM1048EN: Reach through the crowd like the woman who touched His hem, and find in one heartbeat that all of you belongs to Jesus.
descriptions.AMIM1049EN: Run every road to its wall and you'll find Jesus standing right where the roads give out, the Way through them all.
descriptions.AMIM1050EN: Unpack the midnight bag and set a thin cup on the shelf: the restless running is over, because Jesus sat you down for good.
descriptions.AMIM1051EN: No half, no hold, no loan: hand Jesus the room, the rafters and the throne of a heart that is finally undivided.
descriptions.AMIM1052EN: Beyond the laden table and the woven blue, discover the real treasure under your roof is Jesus Himself.
descriptions.AMIM1053EN: Three dark days, then the sun: stand at the empty tomb with the stone rolled back and let Easter hope flood in.
descriptions.AMIM1054EN: Bring your years of trying, watch the ledger burn, and breathe the freedom of a debt Jesus paid before you owed it.
descriptions.AMIM1055EN: Stay close behind your Rabbi on the gravel road, turning where He turns, and let following Jesus become simple again.
descriptions.AMIM1056EN: Not a number on a census but a bell its Maker struck once: hear how completely Jesus knows you, and ring true.
descriptions.AMIM1057EN: Don't wait for the brave ones to start: be first on the floor and give God the very first of your gladness.
descriptions.AMIM1058EN: That road you thought was built for one has an extra set of footsteps, matching yours stride for stride through the dark.
descriptions.AMIM1059EN: Whatever names they've called you, the deepest thing about you is God's thumbprint, pressed in while the clay was warm.
descriptions.AMIM1060EN: Trade winter grey for crimson and feel spring start beating in your chest, proof that God makes a genuine fresh start.
descriptions.AMIM1061EN: Let it pour and howl all night: peace was never the weather, it is a Person sitting beside you in the storm.
descriptions.AMIM1062EN: Grip a rope whose far end is tied to Jesus, not to the weather or the stars, for a hope that holds when others fray.
descriptions.AMIM1063EN: Hang your whole day on two golden hinges, the first prayer at sunrise and the last as the lamps go dim.
descriptions.AMIM1064EN: Stop begging for the whole highway lit: God's word shows the next stone, and the next stone is enough to get you home.
descriptions.AMIM1065EN: Not a thunderclap but a Hand that stays: rest on the table while Jesus binds your ache, turn by patient turn.
descriptions.AMIM1066EN: Leave an empty chair for the stranger, because the One who made room for you keeps sending guests to your door.
descriptions.AMIM1067EN: Your promise isn't sleeping, it's ripening in the dark, so take heart through every unmarked morning of waiting.
descriptions.AMIM1068EN: Stop counting down to real life: eternity broke in the day Jesus called your name, and it is already here.
descriptions.CAIM1001EN: Hold the rope when the midnight phone call hits: the waves still crash, but your soul stays fastened to Christ.
descriptions.CAIM1002EN: Blow on the embers under the ash until your heart burns again like the travellers on the Emmaus road.
descriptions.CAIM1003EN: Sit at the foot of your Jericho wall, hear the first crack, then walk out into open sky with the chains behind you.
descriptions.CAIM1004EN: From the back row to 'Here am I, send me': hear God speak your name long before you ever felt worthy of it.
descriptions.CAIM1004HR: Pozvan i izabran: the God who looks at the heart calls the unnoticed one forward and sends them out with purpose.
descriptions.CAIM1005EN: Your shaking voice can be the sermon: tell what Jesus did on the kitchen floor at 2 AM, trembling line by line.
descriptions.CAIM1006EN: The bloodline speaks, but heaven speaks louder: break the old family curse and hand a blessing to the children after you.
descriptions.CAIM1006TL: Mahaba ang hapag: a long table, an empty chair filled, and a blessing strong enough to outlast the family curse.
descriptions.CAIM1007EN: The door slammed behind you, but His hand did not: come home to dry bones rising and mourning turned to dancing.
descriptions.CAIM1007TL: Years in the wilderness end at a table still set: turn the wheel toward home and be welcomed without a single question.
descriptions.CAIM1008DE: Lay the weight down at His feet and hear a new name spoken, because your worst day is not the end of your story.
descriptions.CAIM1008EN: Name what you kept hidden, lay it on the table, and stand tall again as grace meets you on your very worst day.
descriptions.CAIM1008HI: Shame loses its grip here: bring the unspoken to the Father and rise out of hiding with your head lifted high.
descriptions.CAIM1009EN: For the 3:47 AM ache that will not close: slow mercy, a Healer who stays, and scars that learn to sing.
descriptions.CAIM1009UR: No pretending required: the Healer sits with your wound, binds up the broken heart, and simply refuses to leave.
descriptions.CAIM1009VI: Balm of Gilead for your tender places, and a quiet road home where every scar slowly becomes a song.
descriptions.CAIM1010EN: Tune out the loud news and notice a mustard-seed kingdom already growing at your Tuesday table.
descriptions.CAIM1010ZH: The whisper becomes a tree and the seed becomes a roar: hope that heaven is already breaking into ordinary days.
descriptions.CAIM1011EN: Carry a flame that survived war, grief and long obedience, borrowed from the Father and still burning for your children.
descriptions.CAIM1012EN: Step inside and breathe: Jesus is both the door and the room, walls of shelter around every anxious breath.
descriptions.CAIM1012MS: Hide in the cleft of the rock while the nations rage, sheltered by the One who takes refuge right beside you.
descriptions.CAIM1012VI: Be still beneath His wings, drink from a river of refuge, and let the Strong Tower stand guard over your night.
descriptions.CAIM1013EN: One whispered name at the railing became a rescue: first days clean, marriages revived, and scars that tell His story.
descriptions.CAIM1014EN: Stand at a February graveside with the God who weeps at tombs, then watch the green shoot break through the frost.
descriptions.CAIM1014IT: Speranza for grief's long winter: the Lord who wept at Lazarus's tomb still calls the dead out into spring.
descriptions.CAIM1014RO: Three long days give way to a garden morning where the stone is rolled away and the Risen One calls you by name.
descriptions.CAIM1015EN: Run to the tomb with Mary at dawn and find the great stone already rolled back, no Roman seal able to hold your King.
descriptions.CAIM1015IT: Alleluia at sunrise: an empty tomb, a full heart, and a Sunday shout that death has lost for good.
descriptions.CAIM1015TA: Easter joy you can shout: the Lord of the Sabbath walked out of the grave without asking permission, and He lives.
descriptions.CAIM1016AF: Unclench the fist you have held for years and discover the freedom of an open hand surrendered to Jesus.
descriptions.CAIM1016DA: Stop bargaining at the kitchen table: Jesus asks for the grip itself, and letting go becomes the lightest thing you carry.
descriptions.CAIM1016EN: Bring the half you have been holding back and learn, cross in hand, how sweet it is to finally let go.
descriptions.CAIM1017BN: Knock on the front door and hear Jesus throw it open: there is a chair in His house with your name on it.
descriptions.CAIM1017EN: No more arriving alone: walk in, break the bread, and find the family that chose you and keeps you.
descriptions.CAIM1017PT: Pull up a chair, the table is wide: go from stranger to brother or sister in a house full of laughter.
descriptions.CAIM1018EN: Lace up your shoes, pack the minivan and carry the fire to your own block, with the Holy Spirit steering the road.
descriptions.CAIM1019EN: The porch light is on and the table needs another leaf: come home to long hugs on the doormat and a family made whole.
descriptions.CAIM1020EN: Tell doubt it cannot have you, stand with the Hebrews 11 faithful, and shout I believe, help me believe more.
descriptions.CAIM1021EN: Grab the congas and head for the rooftops: brass, drums and a dance until sunrise, because Jesus is worth celebrating today.
descriptions.CAIM1021PT: Hands raised high and feet already moving: Celebra Jesus já is joy in Portuguese that refuses to wait for later.
descriptions.CAIM1022EN: Feel the room shift when Jesus walks in, a Hammond-soaked Sunday wave of presence that never leaves the floor.
descriptions.CAIM1023EN: All rise: stomp the floor, lift the banner and roar with the Lion of Judah as every old kingdom shakes before Him.
descriptions.CAIM1024EN: Pull up the big chair for King Jesus, run the old rivals out, and let a talking-drum hallelujah crown Him inside you.
descriptions.CAIM1025EN: Kneel on the marble floor of the King's court and feel your bowing turn to dancing beneath a thunder of holy, holy, holy.
descriptions.CAIM1026EN: No sitting still: tambourines, clavinet and hands up high for a joy that dances right on into eternity.
descriptions.CAIM1027EN: Heaven's party has already begun: get on the floor with the King and taste a celebration eternity will never end.
descriptions.CAIM1028EN: The trumpet sounds, the white horse is saddled, and chains hit the floor as Christ returns for a thousand years of yes.
descriptions.CAIM1029AF: Geen groter liefde: kneel at the cross and receive a love that laid absolutely everything down for you.
descriptions.CAIM1029EN: Run to the cross with hands up and heart wide, receive the love He laid down, then pass it on to someone else.
descriptions.CAIM1029HR: Let the Friend who laid down His life carry you to the table, where a love that stays is waiting for you.
descriptions.CAIM1030EN: Before the sun ever rose you were already His: shout from the rooftops that nothing can separate you from that love.
descriptions.CAIM1030FA: Rest in a love with no end and no conditions, the anchor that holds when everything else lets go.
descriptions.CAIM1030PL: Every generation, louder: a celebration without end for hearts that know nothing can pull them from God's love.
descriptions.CAIM1031EN: In a world of a thousand voices, lift one Name above them all, the open Door where every seeker is welcomed home.
descriptions.CAIM1031UR: One Mediator, one Way, one Name under heaven that saves: sing it loud until every knee bows.
descriptions.CAIM1031ZH: Confess with your mouth, believe in your heart, and step through the Door into the family of God's children.
descriptions.CAIM1032DE: Open your mother's worn Bible and find the old words still sharper, louder and truer than the noise of a tilting world.
descriptions.CAIM1032EN: Older than the mountains and louder than the noise: hear Scripture speak to you today and stand on a rock that won't move.
descriptions.CAIM1032LA: Verba antiqua: a lamp for your feet sung in Latin, the living Word no page can contain and no century can silence.
descriptions.CAIM1033EN: Trade a borrowed faith of steeples and ritual for a real Friend who meets you on holy ground and walks with you daily.
descriptions.CAIM1033FR: Grandma's hymns and Sunday clothes give way to morning coffee with Jesus: a Friend, not a boss, who is finally yours.
descriptions.CAIM1033YUE: He knocked first: open the door and discover Jesus as the Friend beside you, not a form, a rite or a steeple.
descriptions.CAIM1034EN: From dead man walking to born again: the day He found you, a heart of stone was traded for a brand new one.
descriptions.CAIM1035EN: Set down the exhausting work of earning God's love and breathe the freedom of a grace that finished it all at the cross.
descriptions.CAIM1035FA: Walk out of the cage of trying harder with empty hands, and discover grace sufficient for your weakest hour.
descriptions.CAIM1035FR: Fatigué d'essayer: lay down the striving, open empty hands at the kitchen table, and let grace set you truly free.
descriptions.CAIM1035RO: Come boldly to the throne with empty hands and find that where sin piled high, grace poured out so much more.
descriptions.CAIM1036EN: Silence the mirror that lies and hear the Father's voice at the river call you His own, sealed, adopted and deeply loved.
descriptions.CAIM1036PL: Lay down the borrowed names and cry Abba: hidden in Christ, you are an heir of the promise, named and never forgotten.
descriptions.CAIM1037EN: Choose a covenant over a moment: love that Jesus signed in blood is worth the wait and stronger than many waters.
descriptions.CAIM1038DA: Jesus stands up inside the storm, not outside it: find peace in the boat while the wind still refuses to sit down.
descriptions.CAIM1038EN: Your panic does not frighten Jesus: lean on the One who stayed in the room and receive a peace the world can't give.
descriptions.CAIM1038YUE: When the wind won't stop howling, the Shepherd walks you through the valley and your anchor holds until the day breaks.
descriptions.CAIM1039EN: Beyond the paycheck, the brand and the platform lies your real calling: God's handiwork, placed here for such a time as this.
descriptions.CAIM1040EN: Leave the shallow water of easy answers and sink your roots deep through fasting, solitude and the quiet years.
descriptions.CAIM1041EN: Stand tall in the cultural wind with truth in love, armor on, and Christ Himself as the line you will never let go.
descriptions.CAIM1042EN: Build an altar at the Sunday-morning table and a bedtime prayer that passes the lamp to a thousand generations.
descriptions.CAIM1043EN: Bedhead hallelujahs, coffee-pot cymbals and truck-cab doxologies: stop waiting for Sunday to sing.
descriptions.CAIM1044EN: Faith was never meant to be a solo act: find the brother who calls at 11:47 PM and a church house that stands.
descriptions.CAIM1045EN: An empty tomb on the corner of your street is news too good to keep: open your mouth and let the whole block know.
descriptions.CAIM1046EN: Face the midnight mirror, drop the costume, and discover that the holiness He asks for is the holiness He gives.
descriptions.CAIM1047EN: Meet the Fourth Man in the furnace you never chose, and walk out refined like gold without even the smell of smoke.
descriptions.CAIM1048EN: The sky is preaching and the trees are praying: see the Maker in creation and know you were knit together on purpose.
descriptions.CAIM1049EN: From the cross to the rolled stone to the Bridegroom on the horizon: lift your eyes, every tear will be wiped away.
descriptions.CAIM1050EN: Quit the scroll-fed hunt for more and shout in the pantry: Christ fills open hands, and gratitude turns into generosity.
descriptions.CAIM1051EN: The fire chief who saved everyone finally cries out, and the Rescuer in white carries him through a door still open for you.
descriptions.CAIM1052EN: A coat with no soot, a door where no door was: follow the witnesses' whispers until the stranger in the smoke has a Name.
descriptions.CAIM1053EN: While the whole world runs out of the burning house, One runs in for you; take His hand and let courage replace your fear.
descriptions.CAIM1054EN: The hands that pulled everyone else out finally open, and a proud strong man learns the freedom of being carried by grace.
descriptions.CAIM1055EN: Pride held the line for years, yet one cry from the smoke was enough, and heaven kicked the door in to answer it.
descriptions.CAIM1056EN: Lungs full of morning, smoke off your skin: walk out the front door alive and wear your scars as proof you were rescued.
descriptions.CAIM1057EN: No plan left, blind in the smoke: feel a hand close on your wrist and be led out step by step by the One who came for your name.
descriptions.CAIM1058EN: Past the sealed door, past the fire no crew can fight, even past the grave, there is no place your Rescuer cannot reach.
descriptions.CAIM1059EN: Lay down the need to be strong enough: where your best training runs out, His power is just getting started.
descriptions.CAIM1060EN: When the haze clears at dawn, one image stays: a Savior who walked the fire and came out clean, brighter than anything that burned.
descriptions.CAIM1061EN: Ring the bell and watch the footwork: Christ takes the knockdown, the arena goes silent, then He rises to win the fight for you.
descriptions.CAIM1062EN: Faith on a plateau is not faith lost: drop the mask, sit at the table, and let grace grow like seed while you sleep.
descriptions.CASM1001EN: Feel heaven's heartbeat pound through your speakers, and let a rising wall of sound remind you who holds the throne.
descriptions.CASM1002EN: Revival is here and Jesus is moving: crank up the guitars and let a sleeping heart wake to fresh fire.
descriptions.CASM1003EN: For nights you feel outmatched, a stadium-sized shout that Jesus is King and nothing can stop what He started in you.
descriptions.CASM1004EN: Hand this to the young believer facing a hard crowd: courage to stand tall and unashamed, because Jesus is King.
descriptions.CASM1005EN: Walls falling, chains breaking, light flooding in: shout breakthrough over whatever has kept you boxed in.
descriptions.CASM1006EN: The Lion of Judah is rising in might, so lift your head and roar back at the fear that ruled your night.
descriptions.CASM1007EN: Like Elisha's servant with opened eyes, see heaven's burning armies surrounding you and stop being afraid.
descriptions.CASM1008EN: By the blood of the Lamb and the word of your testimony, win the fight you've been losing and walk out an overcomer.
descriptions.CASM1009EN: Lace up and march in the light: a battle cry for believers ready to stand firm and win by His might, not their own.
descriptions.CASM1010EN: The tomb could not hold Him, so let resurrection life surge through you with every chorus that Jesus lives forever.
descriptions.CASM1011EN: Right where you stand, the King's presence burns bright, turning an ordinary room into a place to bow in awe.
descriptions.CASM1012EN: Thirsty and running dry, wade into the river of Jesus as living water floods the dry places and drowns the night.
descriptions.CASM1013EN: Isaiah's promise at full volume: the Child born for us is the Mighty God, strong enough to light up your darkest night.
descriptions.CASM1014EN: Pray Thy kingdom come with your fists raised, and feel heaven's rule break into the ordinary hours of your life.
descriptions.CASM1015EN: The suffering Servant now wears the crown: stand in awe of the Lamb who was slain and reigns as King over every wound.
descriptions.CASM1016EN: Ascend into the throne room, where Jesus shines so bright that every burden looks small and delight takes over.
descriptions.CASM1017EN: Hungry for more than this world serves, taste Jesus, the Bread who satisfies and breaks the heart's long night.
descriptions.CASM1018EN: Every promise around you cracking, lean hard on the Rider whose very name is truth, and who holds you tight.
descriptions.CASM1019EN: Lift your voice with heaven's crowd and let praise for the glorified King fill a night you thought would stay silent.
descriptions.CASM1020EN: Mighty enough to rule, tender enough to carry a lamb: rest in the strong arms of the King who shepherds you home.
descriptions.CASM1021EN: Throw the doors open and throw a party for Jesus tonight, with joy loud enough to shake off a heavy week.
descriptions.CASM1022EN: Lift your voice until the room shakes with it: Jesus is on the throne, and nothing you face tonight outranks Him.
descriptions.CASM1023EN: Chant the name Isaiah foretold until the storm inside you gives way to a peace that dances.
descriptions.CASM1024EN: Every lesser crown bows here, a floor-shaking call to worship the One who holds every throne in His hand.
descriptions.CASM1025EN: Taste the thousand years of Revelation 20 now, a pulsing foretaste of the day the King sets every wrong right.
descriptions.CASM1026EN: One word shouted over and over, until heaven's thunderous roar from Revelation 19 becomes your own.
descriptions.CASM1027EN: Pull up a chair at the banquet Jesus promised, where the hungry are filled and the table never runs out.
descriptions.CASM1028EN: See the thorn-crowned Savior now wearing glory, and feel your own head lift as you sing Him higher.
descriptions.CASM1029EN: The grave lost and the enemy is disarmed: step into Christ's victory parade and march out of defeat for good.
descriptions.CASM1030EN: Kings rise and fall, but His kingdom has no end, and that steady beat is solid ground under restless feet.
descriptions.CASM1031EN: Join the elders casting their crowns before the throne, and let every trophy you carry fall at His feet.
descriptions.CASM1032EN: Keep your lamp burning: a midnight shout of readiness that fills waiting hearts with glad expectation.
descriptions.CASM1033EN: Heaven's wedding bells ring on the downbeat, and the Bride dressed in white is you, loved, washed and ready.
descriptions.CASM1034EN: Drawn with lovingkindness and held without end, let Jeremiah 31:3 pound through you until you finally believe it.
descriptions.CASM1035EN: Death has lost its sting, so throw your hands up with the joy of people who already know how the story ends.
descriptions.CASM1036EN: Your King comes riding in humble and righteous, so shout like Zion did and let gladness outrun your worry.
descriptions.CASM1037EN: We love because He first loved us, and here that simple truth becomes a shout the whole room can join.
descriptions.CASM1038EN: Righteousness, peace and joy in the Holy Spirit: feel Romans 14:17 come alive in a party that lifts heavy hearts.
descriptions.CASM1039EN: Learn tonight the new song heaven sings forever, and find your voice among every tribe and tongue around the throne.
descriptions.CASM1040EN: The kingdoms of this world have become His: sing it now and walk into tomorrow knowing exactly who wins.
descriptions.CEF001EN: Knock-knock jokes, wiggles and glowing giggles teach little ones who Jesus says He is, and who He says they are.
descriptions.EAIM1001EN: When whispers fail and the backup plans run dry, say one Name out loud in the middle of nowhere and watch the devil flinch.
descriptions.EAIM1001HI: Bas yahi naam: in crisis, in the dark, in the middle of nowhere, one Name is a strong tower you can run into and be safe.
descriptions.EAIM1001RO: No backup plan required: the Name that found you first still answers, from the kitchen table to the end of the dirt road.
descriptions.EAIM1002EN: Sit at Grandmother's knee and inherit a lineage of light, a thread of prayer that held your family long before you knew it.
descriptions.EAIM1003EN: Spring thaw, summer strength, autumn letting go, winter testing: learn to trust the God whose faithfulness never changes season.
descriptions.EAIM1004EN: Sink roots deep enough to weather anything, then stand tall as an oak of righteousness and pass the torch to those rising next.
descriptions.EAIM1005EN: Answer the quiet questions, leave footsteps worth following, and hand the children in your life a faith they can carry for good.
descriptions.EAIM1006EN: Every frayed thread and tangled knot belongs in the Master Weaver's hands, and He unravels nothing He cannot weave back stronger.
descriptions.EAIM1007EN: Faces remembered, voices in the night, light passed hand to hand: walk the road of the saints and learn to number your days wisely.
descriptions.EAIM1008EN: Pull up a chair by the fire: there is a seat at the table with your name already on it, and Jesus is the One saving it.
descriptions.EAIM1009EN: When the years have taken everything they can, faith, hope and love are still standing, the treasure no one can steal.
descriptions.EAIM1010EN: Hum along with Grandmother's psalm and let Christ the Teacher tuck His truth into melodies your heart will remember for life.
descriptions.EAIM1011EN: Your story is not too small: join the cloud of witnesses and hear how one ordinary testimony can carry faith to a whole generation.
descriptions.EAIM1012EN: Learn the names, bear the burdens, and watch the Good Shepherd pull up a chair for the one still on the way.
descriptions.EAIM1013EN: Fire shut up in your bones and a Lord who does not move: find the nerve to speak His truth clear, kind and completely unashamed.
descriptions.EAIM1014EN: The Teacher never stopped teaching: pick up the Word from a mentor's hand and discover Jesus is still sending ordinary people out.
descriptions.EAIM1015EN: Put the kettle on and set down what hurts: Jesus heals without hurrying, keeps no scorecard, and makes it safe to finally mend.
descriptions.EAIM1016EN: Your kitchen is holy ground: invite Jesus into the daily rhythms and feel your whole house breathe with His peace.
descriptions.EAIM1017EN: Before the next big decision, listen for the quieter voice, because every yes that lasts is a yes Jesus made first.
descriptions.EAIM1018EN: Listen, daughter: the faith your mothers carried was saved all these years for you, and Jesus says you are ready to carry it on.
descriptions.EAIM1019EN: Somebody left the porch light on for you, and it burns steady until the Father runs down the steps to bring you home.
descriptions.EAIM1020EN: Trade scarcity for open hands: the God who feeds the ravens and multiplies a boy's lunch has already seen what you need.
descriptions.EAIM1021EN: Your voice was never borrowed: stand with Deborah, Priscilla and Phoebe and speak with the authority Jesus gives His daughters.
descriptions.EAIM1022EN: Worn boots, two in the morning in a parking lot, come as you are: mercy is holding the door and the altar stays open all night.
descriptions.EAIM1023EN: Carry a sobriety chip and a new song: the God who marked every mile of the hard road can restore the years the locusts ate.
descriptions.EAIM1024EN: Bring the sack too heavy to carry, the empty chair and the year he walked away, and leave lighter than you came.
descriptions.EAIM1024RO: Lasă-le la cruce: every sorrow you have hauled alone was already borne at Calvary, so set it down and trade it for joy.
descriptions.EAIM1025EN: The One who found a thirsty woman at a well will find you too, past the midnight DMs and hotel mirrors, and call you by name.
descriptions.EAIM1026EN: Pink neon buzzing at the blue hour could never satisfy, so walk out of the glow into a Light far brighter than the sign.
descriptions.EAIM1027EN: The bottle promised to quench the thirst and lied, but the Shepherd fills your cup with living water until it runs over.
descriptions.EAIM1028EN: A heart of stone made flesh, vows renewed on the porch, a ring slipped back on: God can bring a wandering heart all the way home.
descriptions.EAIM1029EN: Bring the wild years and the calloused hands: sins like scarlet turn white as snow, and a sober Sunday morning becomes holy ground.
descriptions.EAIM1030EN: Years of tears cried into a glass can finally land on a shoulder wide enough to hold them, where God keeps every one in His bottle.
descriptions.EAIM1031EN: Turn the truck around: while you are still a great way off, the Father has left the porch and is running to you.
descriptions.EAIM1032EN: Grief loosens its grip when your feet remember how to move: dance like David, with the Holy Spirit leading the band.
descriptions.EAIM1033EN: Not managed but healed: say it out loud with the redeemed and let the word of your testimony become someone else's way out.
descriptions.EAIM1034EN: Jesus slips in the side door, knows every regular by name, and at closing time walks the broken ones home.
descriptions.EAIM1035EN: On the cold tile at rock bottom, God did not shout from above: He got down on the floor beside you and set your feet on a rock.
descriptions.EAIM1036EN: Granite, not sandstone: when grief and a wayward child shake everything, stand where generations have stood, on Christ the Rock.
descriptions.EAIM1037EN: Ride the two-lane miles to the cancer clinic with a truck-stop hymn at dawn and the Father at the wheel all the way home.
descriptions.EAIM1038EN: Mascara on the hymnal, knees on the worn velvet, just as you are: kneel down heavy and stand up forgiven.
descriptions.EAIM1039EN: The same hands that held you at eleven on Saturday night will lead you up the church steps to a pew three rows from the back.
descriptions.EAIM1040EN: The bartender brings the ledger, but the tab is already marked paid in full at Calvary, so walk out owing nothing.
descriptions.EAIM1041EN: Hold a funeral for who you used to be, then stomp the grave flat on a resurrection dance floor and pull a sister up to join you.
descriptions.ELIM1001EN: Frontier dust on your boots and smoke rising from the altar: saddle the storm, never look back, and ride toward the trumpet.
descriptions.ELIM1002EN: After the devil rides at midnight and the whiskey lies run dry, mercies break new over the ridge and boots find the road to glory.
descriptions.ELIM1003EN: Red lipstick, a loaded smile, a sweet hellfire lullaby: see through every disguise, because chains cannot dance in holy fire.
descriptions.ELIM1004EN: Leave the comfortable pews for the margins, where the hungry are fed, the silence breaks, and the gospel is most alive.
descriptions.ELIM1005EN: The land remembers what was taken, and a grandmother's prayer rises with it toward a God of Jubilee who keeps every covenant.
descriptions.ELIM1006EN: Pull a log up to the fire where covenant is kept: even when you broke your word, Jesus kept His, and you still belong.
descriptions.ELIM1007EN: Prison cell prayers, midnight grace and scars that testify: from the lowest dust, God is still raising people up to glory.
descriptions.ELIM1008EN: Pick up the prophet's burden with Amos, speak for the voiceless, and trust that truth keeps marching when the world goes quiet.
descriptions.ELIM1009EN: A fiddle cries from the holler, Pentecost falls on the Smokies, and a still small voice calls wandering hearts home to the hills.
descriptions.ELIM1010EN: When the church owns its failures toward the poor and the widow and kneels in honest confession, the road back to God opens wide.
descriptions.ELIM1011EN: Coal dust, mill bells, fields and double shifts: every calloused hand is holy ground, and God sees the work nobody thanks you for.
descriptions.ELIM1012EN: Rushing wind on the ridges and Pentecost fire on the mountain: lift your voice and pray the heavens open over your valley.
descriptions.ELIM1013EN: Oil rigs, border towns and ranch fences on red dirt: the God who owns the cattle on a thousand hills redeems the outlaw too.
descriptions.ELIM1014EN: Banjos rolling, fiddles racing and feet stomping on sawmill floors: pure Appalachian joy that turns mourning into a hallelujah.
descriptions.ELIM1015EN: When the trail ends at sundown, lay the saddle down in peace, because Jesus rides with you all the way past the last horizon.
descriptions.ELIM1016EN: Build on the Rock with gold that survives the fire, then hand the work to the next generation and watch the seed multiply.
descriptions.ELIM1017EN: Saddle up with a Savior who is still sending: the same Jesus who builds His church rides ahead of you onto every new frontier.
descriptions.ELIM1018EN: Heal the father wound, break the cycle and speak the blessing your son has waited for, with Abba Father standing right beside you.
descriptions.ELIM1019EN: Out on the open range the Shepherd still hollers for the wanderer: answer the call and build your life on solid ground.
descriptions.ELIM1020EN: Before you lead anyone, follow the One who called you first: faithful in small things, tested in the wilderness, then sent.
descriptions.ELIM1021EN: Step into the desert silence where distractions burn away and the still small voice speaks clearly enough to send you out changed.
descriptions.ELIM1022EN: Stop calling the broken thing something else: that is exactly where Jesus meets you, and where His road home begins.
descriptions.ELIM1022HI: Walk the Emmaus road with a patient Repairer who mends what is shattered one step at a time until nothing is left unrestored.
descriptions.ELIM1023EN: When the pressure comes, lean on a Lord who does not move, and feel iron settle into your spine for whatever storm is next.
descriptions.ELIM1024EN: The God who sees hears every widow's cry, and the Rider on the white horse is coming to set wrong things right, so take courage.
descriptions.ELIM1025EN: Cold river water rising round the knees holds no fear when Jesus wades in beside you and the saints wave from the far bank.
descriptions.ELIM1026EN: Follow the gravel road up the mountain to a cabin with your name on the deed and supper already on the table in the Father's house.
descriptions.ELIM1027EN: Every switchback and scree slope counts: catch a second wind from the One climbing beside you until the summit bell rings.
descriptions.ELIM1028EN: Spent it all and staring into a pigpen mirror, you are still one decision from a running Father, a robe, a ring and a feast.
descriptions.ELIM1028RO: From the far country back up the stony road, find your rehearsed apology interrupted by a Father's embrace and a welcome feast.
descriptions.ELIM1029EN: A rust-stained nail and a receipt written in crimson: your name is in the Lamb's book, so walk like you belong to Him.
descriptions.ELIM1030EN: Through the long night at Mama's bedside the Shepherd stays close, and morning breaks over the grave with the promise of reunion.
descriptions.ELIM1030RO: From an empty chair at supper to sunrise on the grave, grief finds a Shepherd who walks the dark valley right beside you.
descriptions.ELIM1031EN: Hear the train whistle in the dark and remember this world is only a depot: your Father is already waiting at the gate.
descriptions.ELIM1032EN: Calloused hands, a leather Bible by the bed, a porch full of hymns: inherit the faith that held your family and hand it down.
descriptions.ELIM1033EN: Step into a church with no walls, where the mist is incense, the creek bed is the aisle, and every ridge sings His praise.
descriptions.ELIM1034EN: Coal dust on your knees and a hammer ringing hallelujah: find God in the work of your hands and rest waiting at His table.
descriptions.ELIM1035EN: His boots still wait by the door and his coffee has gone cold, yet an empty tomb promises you will meet again by the river.
descriptions.ELIM1036EN: Pink slip on Sunday, wind howling at the cabin door: tie your soul to the anchor that holds when everything else lets go.
descriptions.ELIM1037EN: Trim your lamp and watch the eastern sky from the porch, because the King is coming and midnight never gets the last word.
descriptions.ELIM1038EN: Kneel down heavy with hot tears in the dust, then rise to a running Father, a robe, a ring, and a burden left behind.
descriptions.ELIM1039EN: Grandma's stove hymn, a prodigal still out there, a new cradle on the porch: Christ holds every link of the family chain.
descriptions.ELIM1040EN: Pray over the empty cupboard and watch Sunday's pot roast stretch: the God of manna and five loaves still feeds His kids.
descriptions.ELIM1041EN: Turn the truck around and drive forty miles of gravel home: the Father never blew out the light He left burning for you.
descriptions.ELIM1042EN: Two years past the foreclosure and still standing: plant your feet on Christ, the one foundation no earthquake can crack.
descriptions.ELIM1043EN: Joy came back one morning for a grieving widow, and it is contagious: clap, stomp and let the joy of the Lord be your strength.
descriptions.ELIM1044EN: From a bathroom floor at 3:47 in the morning to a kitchen table with Jesus: a testimony so plain you will want to tell your own.
descriptions.ELIM1045EN: Shout His name down the holler and hold a lantern for the lost, because heaven is filling up and a seat is saved for one more.
descriptions.IMIM1001EN: The Hammond hits one chord and the room where you used to hide swings open: shout-church freedom that sends you out different.
descriptions.IMIM1002EN: Say the chain's name out loud to Jesus, addiction, fear or a family curse, then dance on it to the drums of heaven.
descriptions.IMIM1002HI: Bediyan Tod Do, break the chains: Hindi voices name addiction and fear before Jesus, then dance free over the broken iron.
descriptions.IMIM1003EN: The long battle is over: take your first free breath as the phone rings, the marriage reopens and every morning starts unchained.
descriptions.IMIM1004EN: Grab the mic and tell what Jesus did last Tuesday, because your testimony is a weapon that sends fear and shame packing.
descriptions.IMIM1005EN: Oil in the bottle and the prayer team in the room: receive freedom, then feel the mantle land on you to lay hands on someone else.
descriptions.IMIM1006EN: Wait with the hundred and twenty until the wind roars and the flames fall, then carry Acts 2 out onto your own street.
descriptions.IMIM1007EN: Lay the crown, the bottle and the anger on the altar and let holy fire take them: what survives is gold, and you walk away light.
descriptions.IMIM1008EN: Grandma's 5 AM prayers are still holding: stand in a line of blessing that breaks old curses and reaches children not yet born.
descriptions.IMIM1009EN: Wade in with your wound, ankle deep, then waist deep, then over your head, until the river of God calls you by name.
descriptions.IMIM1010EN: The Promise still stands for you: be filled with Holy Ghost power, find a new prayer language, and go out sealed and sent.
descriptions.IMIM1011EN: Sing hymns at midnight like Paul and Silas, keep the 3 AM watch, and feel the prison shake until sunrise paints the wall.
descriptions.IMIM1012EN: On the 149th Street platform and the 6 train, the Carpenter of Nazareth still works wonders and restores the years the locust ate.
descriptions.IMIM1013EN: The upper room never closed: wherever two or three gather, the same fire falls, the Hammond vamps on and the devil has to leave.
descriptions.IMIM1014EN: Hear the Father call you daughter, feel the coal touch your lips, then speak life over dry bones, your house and your bloodline.
descriptions.IMIM1015EN: Keep a pen by the bed: when a 3 AM dream comes in color, learn to hear Jesus in it, write it plain and walk it out.
descriptions.IMIM1016EN: Kick off your shoes on the threshing floor, grab a tambourine and dance like David, because shame has lost your address.
descriptions.IMIM1017EN: March seven days around your Jericho, then shout and watch walls of anxiety, addiction and lack fall at a Holy Ghost block party.
descriptions.IMIM1018EN: Kneel at the altar your grandmother knelt at and pray in the Spirit's language, a fire still falling on your children's children.
descriptions.IMIM1019EN: From a bus to Calabar to a Soweto sunrise and a Mumbai basement, the same Holy Ghost falls, and He can fill your kitchen too.
descriptions.IMIM1020EN: The trombones walk in and revival follows: tears in the aisle, baptisms in the river, and families walking home together again.
descriptions.IMIM1021EN: Open your eyes on a New Orleans street and see what God sees over your marriage, your children and the city He is about to wake.
descriptions.IMIM1022EN: Pentecost did not stay in Jerusalem: the fire hits the pew on an ordinary Tuesday and sends you out the door carrying the flame.
descriptions.IMIM1023EN: Slip into the pew at the back wall and linger: the glory cloud is coming, and His presence is a place to live, not just visit.
descriptions.IMIM1024EN: Climb to the rooftop and lift hands that will not come down: praise so bold the whole city, and your grandchildren, will hear it.
descriptions.IMIM1025EN: Walk into the fight knowing the verdict is already in: even limping, you take a victory lap, because the battle is the Lord's.
descriptions.IMIM1026EN: Reach for His hem from the waiting room: a Hammond like balm, a river that finds the wound, and faith for when the report says no.
descriptions.IMIM1027EN: Six laps, one trumpet, then a crash: watch walls of shame and addiction fall and find a door waiting on the other side.
descriptions.IMIM1028EN: Hold on like Hannah and count stars like Abraham: faith for the day of the diagnosis and every night you keep hoping against hope.
descriptions.IMIM1029EN: Bitterness snaps, fear hits the floor, and you are free to dance out the door or simply stand still in the love that loosed you.
descriptions.IMIM1030EN: A quartet greets the sunrise with news worth waking for: mercy showed up again, and the hand that held you all night holds on.
descriptions.IMIM1031EN: The drums kick first and the Holy Ghost rides the hi-hat, fanning the ember under your ash until lukewarm faith catches fire.
descriptions.IMIM1032EN: Open your hands at the altar bench and whisper yes: the relief of giving Jesus everything and walking out lighter and free.
descriptions.IMIM1033EN: Steelpan, soca and a wave of your hand: Caribbean joy that dances like David and stays strong even when the music goes quiet.
descriptions.IMIM1034EN: Fresh oil poured from the horn, a yoke that snaps, and a word in your mouth: you were set apart before birth and sent with power.
descriptions.IMIM1034KO: In Korean, a preacher's cadence rolls over the Hammond as fresh oil falls, breaking yokes and sending you out with a word.
descriptions.IMIM1034SW: Upako Uko Juu Yangu, the anointing is on me: a Swahili call to receive the oil that teaches, breaks yokes and sends you out.
descriptions.IMIM1035EN: Knees on the carpet, wrestling like Jacob till daybreak: every tear and every name you carry in prayer is written down in heaven.
descriptions.IMIM1035KO: Korean voices tarry at the altar and stand in the gap, calling you to keep knocking like the persistent widow till heaven answers.
descriptions.IMIM1036EN: The God who split the Red Sea and called Lazarus out still makes a way, on the subway, at your quiet kitchen table, right now.
descriptions.IMIM1036RO: El Tot Deschide Calea, He still makes a way: funk-soaked Romanian praise for anyone standing at their own Red Sea tonight.
descriptions.IMIM1036SW: Water from the rock, bread for the multitude and a wall that falls: Swahili praise that says no road is closed to your Way Maker.
descriptions.IMIM1037EN: Two-step through the trouble while a sister tells you not to quit: the night of weeping is real, and so is the sunrise coming.
descriptions.IMIM1037RO: Hold on until dawn: a Romanian shuffle that honors your tears tonight and hands you a garment of praise when morning breaks.
descriptions.IMIM1037TA: Sung in Tamil, a promise for the longest night: weeping may stay a while, but joy is already on its way with the dawn.
descriptions.IMIM1038EN: Run all you want: His goodness chases you down, sets a table in the open field, and keeps your cup running over.
descriptions.IMIM1039EN: Burn the old number, forget the old address, and let the mirror meet someone new: Jesus sends you out wearing a new name.
descriptions.IMIM1040EN: Trombones call you to the mercy seat, where the blood on the doorpost still covers you, your bedside and your grandchildren.
descriptions.IMIM1041EN: Put the armor on and stomp out the lying whisper: after the attack you are still standing, and your daughter keeps the ground.
descriptions.IMIM1042EN: The water is already at your feet: step into the Father's river and let it begin its gentle work on every broken place.
descriptions.IMIM1043EN: Hand the old landlord back his key: over a dancehall riddim the lock gives way, the chains drop, and you are free indeed.
descriptions.IMIM1044EN: From the bottom of the pit to the best robe on your shoulders, grace throws a block party and your name is on the invite.
descriptions.IMIM1045EN: Heaven's gates swing wide, the steelpan rings hallelujah, and every tribe jumps for the Lamb on a road paved with gold.
descriptions.IMIM1046EN: Before you ever knock, the porch light is on and the Father is already running down the road to bring you home.
descriptions.IMIM1047EN: For the morning after the house burned: trade the ashes for oil of joy and watch God restore the years you thought were lost.
descriptions.IMIM1048EN: When the ground rocks, sit a while in Grandma's rocking chair and feel the anchor hold, because nothing moves the One on the throne.
descriptions.IMIM1049EN: Far from home or torn between two, you'll find Jesus saved you a seat at a table wide enough for every accent on earth.
descriptions.IMIM1050EN: Praise before the answer comes: an empty pot still sings, a midnight cell still shakes, and thankful joy riots through the storm.
descriptions.IMIM1051EN: Lace up, trim your lamp and turn every ordinary morning into joyful watching, because the trumpet could sound on the next downbeat.
descriptions.IMIM1052EN: Stop asking the mirror and hear the Maker: you were knit together in secret, signed by His hand, and never meant to be anyone else.
descriptions.IMX503AH: Walk home from the paddy fields beside a soldier whose guilt won't stay buried, and find the courage to face what you carry.
descriptions.IMX504AH: Raise the curtain on Saigon, where black-market deals, a medic in a minefield and ghosts with names refuse to stay silent.
descriptions.IMX505: Discover why you were given a voice, then sing it back to Jesus in English, Romanian and Spanish with a full heart.
descriptions.IMX506: Salt air, wild blooms and a steady promise: someone will still be there tomorrow, and that is enough to breathe easy tonight.
descriptions.IX401EN: Wake the whole house with Rudy the rooster, who flaps, tumbles and crows his way to knowing God made him just right.
descriptions.IX401RO: A funky rooster on a mission crows 'Cucurigu' for redemption, turning your child's morning into a giggling wake-up call for Jesus.
descriptions.IX402EN: Snorts, capes and pirate hats: pug heroes and ninjas turn every giggle into loud, humble praise for the King.
descriptions.IX402RO: Pug pirates, secret agents and a ninja of grace bark through a carnival where kids learn real heroes run on love from above.
descriptions.IX403EN: Jazz hands up for a swamp parade where a brassy gator teaches kids to be brave, blow humble and trust God's tune.
descriptions.IX403RO: Swing through the swamp parade with a jazzy alligator who teaches kids bravery, kindness and passing the baton of faith along.
descriptions.IX404EN: Big ears, bigger faith: stomp out doubt with Earsby the elephant and let your kids drum a jungle-sized yes to God.
descriptions.IX405EN: Rickshaws, saree swirls and a proud peacock who learns his brightest colors are for shining, not showing off.
descriptions.IX405RO: Peacocks bow, share paneer and popcorn and paint the world with praise, teaching your child to make room for the King.
descriptions.IX406EN: Grab the treasure map and dance through the rain to find the gold that lasts: truth, forgiveness and a giving heart.
descriptions.IX407EN: Lanterns glow in the forest as the masks come off, and kids learn they never have to hide from the God who loves them.
descriptions.IX408EN: Stripes, stomps and one roaring Tiggy-Lujah: a bouncy jungle tango that gives wiggly kids a big, happy word for praise.
descriptions.IX409EN: Bounce through the outback, box out doubt and chase a lost boomerang with little ones learning to jump for Jesus.
descriptions.IX410EN: Pin on a tin star: Sheriff Hyde deputizes little cowpokes to stomp on slick lies and stand strong in the name of Jesus.
descriptions.IX410RO: Little feet get their marching orders: stomp, clap and wiggle along with Hyde in a joyful romp made for praise-filled playtime.
descriptions.IX411EN: Swing through the palms with Momo, where a slip on a banana peel ends in giggles, forgiveness and a kid-sized habit of prayer.
descriptions.IX412EN: Crowns on, even sideways: a lion-hearted party that shows kids real royalty roars praise and serves like Jesus.
descriptions.IX413EN: Under the moon, a wise owl helps busy little minds sort their thoughts, say sorry and see the world with Bible eyes.
descriptions.IX414EN: Bubbles, twirls and a splashing choir of whales: pure deep-sea delight for kids who were made to dance for Jesus.
descriptions.IX415EN: Stage fright exits stage left as a not-so-ugly duckling discovers the applause that matters most is heaven's amen.
descriptions.IX416EN: Cobblestones, gondolas and pizza crumbs: a rooftop pigeon choir coos a special delivery of good news across the piazza.
descriptions.IX417EN: Banjo strings get nibbled and the cornbread goes missing at a hoot of a hoedown where sock puppets named Law and Grace star.
descriptions.IX417RO: Banjos meet a Romanian hora as a bouncing goat kicks up its hooves, pulling the family into a circle dance of giggles and praise.
descriptions.IX418EN: Hula, hibiscus and a dolphin's happy splash: an island party that teaches little swimmers to stay in the stream of God's love.
descriptions.IX418RO: Splash and spin with a dolphin under the palms, where coconut choirs and pineapple praise show kids Jesus is near in the waves.
descriptions.IX419EN: Boomba the gorilla grooves right past a hissing snake's lies, so kids learn to spot a trick and swing back to the truth.
descriptions.IX420EN: Pink feathers, yellow shades and roller skates in the Miami heat: strut with Rico and let every flap say hallelujah.
descriptions.IX421EN: A veggie-munching shark with glitter gills proves kindness beats a bite, in an underwater party full of bubbles and giggles.
descriptions.IX422EN: A glowy, hiccuping friend from the sock drawer turns bedtime fears into brave giggles, then tucks everyone in for a snooze.
descriptions.IX423EN: Birthday wiggles, puppy treats and Jesus at the top of the guest list: a party where kids learn every bark belongs to Him.
descriptions.IX423RO: Bella the puppy invites Jesus to her birthday, and your child discovers every bark, snack and happy tail wag can belong to Him.
descriptions.IX424EN: Piñatas, biscuits and a tail-wiggling pup who shares every snack: a fiesta that makes joyful giving feel like a game.
descriptions.IX424RO: Pixie shares the snacks and the piñata, showing kids that joy doubles when it is shared and that God made them playful.
descriptions.IX425EN: Leap through the fields of Galilee with Libi the lamb, where shofars sound and little hooves learn to dance a psalm.
descriptions.IX425RO: Hop through Galilee with Libi the little lamb, where shofar blasts and fig-tree dances turn tiny hooves into hosannas.
descriptions.IX426EN: A badger boogies through the birthday cake and into the baptism tank, keeping kids laughing and learning oops is never the end.
descriptions.IX427EN: Hang upside down and bounce on moonbeams at a glowstick bat party that helps little ones find the light when the dark feels big.
descriptions.IX428EN: A moose who climbs trees in Sunday shoes and snacks on offering envelopes learns, laugh by laugh, to trust God's timing.
descriptions.IX429EN: Tiny lights in a twilight garden teach kids that kind words grow wings and a little faith can shine even at night.
descriptions.IX430EN: Walk to Bethlehem beside a little donkey who learns heaven came through a stable door and the nobodies were invited first.
descriptions.IX431EN: Plod across golden sands with a patient camel and let little travelers find wonder in every gentle sway of the road.
descriptions.IX432EN: A loyal shepherd pup keeps watch over the flock, giving little hearts a cozy picture of the Good Shepherd's care.
descriptions.IX433EN: Curl up in the hay beside a curious barn cat for soft purrs, gentle wonder and the quiet joys of the barn loft.
descriptions.IX434EN: Even the grumpiest old goat can crack a smile, and your kids will trade their frowns for thankful giggles right along with him.
descriptions.IX435EN: Snuggle close to a woolly little lamb and help your child feel how gently the Shepherd carries the smallest of His flock.
descriptions.IX436EN: A soft-winged dove in the rafters of the stable brings a flutter of peace and gentle wonder to little ears.
descriptions.IX437EN: Tiptoe between the pews with a tiny church mouse and show your child that no one is too small for God to notice.
descriptions.IX438EN: Warm up by the hearth with a little sparrow and remind your child that the God who sees every sparrow is watching over them.
descriptions.IX439EN: Climb the rocky ledges with a grumbling mountain goat and cheer as sure feet and a thankful heart reach the top.
descriptions.IX440EN: Hush falls over the snow as a quiet white owl invites little ones into wide-eyed wonder and sleepy, peaceful calm.
descriptions.IX441EN: Hop along with a quick-eared white rabbit for bouncy giggles, soft paws and a child-sized sense of wonder.
descriptions.IX442EN: Every little lamb has a Shepherd who knows its name, and this gentle friend helps children feel safe, known and loved.
descriptions.IX443EN: Northern lights shimmer over the ice as a bright-eyed arctic fox leads kids on a frosty adventure of wonder and delight.
descriptions.IX500EN: Roll the windows down from the ghosts of Gettysburg to rain in Daytona and a Texas tornado of a girl: boot-stomping American fun.
descriptions.IX502EN: Nurse a grudge, dodge a cold-hearted snake, then fall again anyway: honky-tonk heartache that says love is still worth the risk.
descriptions.IX503EN: A folded flag, a brass band playing low, a grandfather's dog tags: stand still and honor the names a small town will not forget.
descriptions.IX504EN: Cleats, crayons and sleepy car rides fade into an empty back seat, a tender goodbye for every parent watching a child take flight.
descriptions.IX505EN: A father's porch-light counsel to his girl: look past the charm and watch for the man who waits, stands steady and holds the door.
descriptions.IX506EN: Chase tail-lights down a Texas road after a runaway breeze of a girl who will not stop for stop signs, or for anybody.
descriptions.IX507EN: Pearl and Hank are there, Mae's heart too, and now your names: a toast to love that lasted long enough to leave its mark at Red's.
descriptions.IX508EN: A hound dog, a set of truck keys and a sprint for the cottonwoods: grin-out-loud country fun for the whole ride home.
descriptions.IX509EN: Stained glass, one candle and too many empty chairs: a quiet companion for the nights grief keeps counting what it lost.
descriptions.IX510EN: The work week is done and Friday is calling: hands up, hold the line and let a stomping chorus shake off every long shift.
descriptions.IX511EN: A pasture for a dance floor and the night sky for a band: grab her hand, stomp your boots and let the fire burn high.
descriptions.IX512EN: Past the silver silo, the slow river and the humming choir to the house where you learned what living means: the road home.
descriptions.IX513EN: Gravel flying on a Friday night, her hand in yours and a borrowed pickup: young love that feels like it could last forever.
descriptions.IX514EN: Coolers in the bed and a fire in the pit: a hometown anthem for the brothers who are not blood but ride with you anyway.
descriptions.IX515EN: A candle cake at the bar, a hot fiddle and a shaking dance floor: the kind of birthday party a whole town shows up for.
descriptions.IX516EN: The show packed up, the bartender nods goodbye, and a man in a paper crown learns what is left: honest company for lonely nights.
descriptions.IX517EN: Slow to rise but burning till the running is done: earn every callus, pray for the rest and climb out of your hometown's shadow.
descriptions.IX518EN: Drop a quarter, spin the needle and watch a room full of lonely people start to shout: one song can change the whole night.
descriptions.IX519EN: Boots back on in the rain, night shifts and saved dollars: courage for anyone rebuilding a life brick by brick after the fall.
descriptions.IX520EN: From Texas to the Tennessee line, a light stays on and a booth waits for the broken and the brave still working it out.
descriptions.IX521EN: A full cup, a fogged window and a goodbye that came too fast: heartbreak that sits with you until you can leave the booth.
descriptions.IX522EN: Eight seconds, a worn-down hope and a daughter watching from the rail: grit for every parent who holds on for the ones they love.
descriptions.IXMH001EN: For the soul that aches to be near the King again, a longing for His Majesty lifted into tender, grateful worship.
descriptions.JEIM1001EN: Lift your eyes for the trumpet on the wind: graves open, the redeemed rise, and your name is already written in the Book.
descriptions.JEIM1001RO: Maranatha from a Romanian heart: the clouds part, the dead in Christ rise, and the long night watch becomes a wedding feast.
descriptions.JEIM1002EN: Run to the tomb with Mary, hear the risen Jesus speak your name, and carry that Sunday morning into every day of the week.
descriptions.JEIM1002RO: From spices carried in the dark to breakfast on the shore, walk with the witnesses until your heart burns on the Emmaus road.
descriptions.JEIM1003EN: Feel the room tilt as holiness comes down, healing walks the aisles, and the dead heart in the back row starts beating again.
descriptions.JEIM1003RO: Raise the first hand in the room, watch captives loosed and ruins rebuilt, then carry that glory out the doors into your street.
descriptions.JEIM1004EN: Yesu, Cristo, Yēsū: hear the whole earth call on one Name and rehearse the song you'll sing around the throne forever.
descriptions.JEIM1004RO: Stand in the throne-room crowd with palm branches in hand, where every language on earth shouts that salvation belongs to our God.
descriptions.JEIM1005EN: Sink your roots by living water and stay green through the drought, trusting the Gardener who only prunes what He loves.
descriptions.JEIM1005RO: Bend without breaking beneath the Vinedresser's careful hand, and find leaves still green and fruit still coming in the dry season.
descriptions.JEIM1006EN: Kneel at the straw where the Word became a baby, and let the light that reached shepherds, weeping Rachel and old Simeon reach you.
descriptions.JEIM1006RO: Christmas for anyone walking in shadow: Mary says yes, the sky blazes with glory, and the Prince of Peace is born for the world.
descriptions.JEIM1007EN: Stay soft on the Potter's wheel: the old self gets buried, your mind is made new, and weakness becomes the place His strength shines.
descriptions.JEIM1007RO: Wet clay today, a crown on the way: surrender to the hands that shape you from glory to glory and never stop making you new.
descriptions.JEIM1008EN: He wore thorns before many crowns: lay yours down beside the elders and join all heaven shouting that the Lamb is worthy.
descriptions.JEIM1008RO: Hear the Lion of Judah roar from the Father's right hand, and bow gladly before the Name that is above every name.
descriptions.JEIM1009EN: Even in the ICU the throne is not empty: find a King who was always in the room and a kingdom no bad news can shake.
descriptions.JEIM1009RO: Borrow courage from a covenant-keeping King whose government rests on His shoulders and whose throne will never stand empty.
descriptions.JEIM1010EN: A grandmother's prayers from the kitchen floor still rise in heaven's golden bowls, and now the mantle passes to you.
descriptions.JEIM1010RO: Kneel on the same knees before the same God and keep the altar fire burning for children who have not yet been born.
descriptions.JEIM1011EN: Shame gets no floor here: laugh like Sarah, out-dance your grief like David, and carry a joy you never had to manufacture into Monday.
descriptions.JEIM1011RO: Wake up dancing: the lie falls, grief loses the argument, and the joy of the Lord becomes strength you can carry out the door.
descriptions.JEIM1012EN: In the wilderness, over the fear and down the cancer ward, the Lion of Judah stayed awake, and His roar will wake the courage in you.
descriptions.JEIM1012RO: Put your hand on the Lion's mane and discover that the One who roars over your fear is also the Lamb who was slain for you.
descriptions.JEIM1013EN: For the empty cradle and the long Saturday silence: bring your 'how long' to God, and be held until joy comes in the morning.
descriptions.JEIM1013HU: Your 'why' is welcome here: honest laments carry you through Saturday's hush to a trembling, brave 'yet I will trust Him'.
descriptions.JEIM1013RO: Tears get words and silence gets company, as sorrow slowly learns to praise and hope holds the door open for morning.
descriptions.JEIM1014EN: Heaven isn't only someday: the kingdom walks into your room, your marketplace and your street, and its door stands wide open.
descriptions.JEIM1014RO: Pray 'Thy kingdom come' and mean it, as the stone cut without hands rolls on and the streets you walk begin to belong to Jesus.
descriptions.JEIM1015CS: Hear the verdict of love read over your life, not guilty and free indeed, and walk out carried by mercy you could never earn.
descriptions.JEIM1015EN: Mercy walks in before you find the words, meets you in the mirror, and sends you into Monday with grace enough to pass on.
descriptions.JEIM1015RO: Grace runs after you, the Advocate speaks up for you, and mercies new every morning follow you all the way home.
descriptions.JEIM1016EN: Watch high places bow, continents bend and islands confess, and rest knowing every ruler you fear will one day kneel to Jesus.
descriptions.JEIM1016RO: Hush before the throne, then shout with the nations: Jesus is Lord over every stronghold, every border and every island of the sea.
descriptions.JEIM1017EN: Bring your hardest question to the altar and stay in the upper room until it catches fire and turns into praise.
descriptions.JEIM1017HU: Honest doubt is welcome at the altar, where the Spirit's yes falls like Pentecost fire and a bush burns without burning out.
descriptions.JEIM1017RO: From Azusa Street to your own quiet room, the fire that fell at Pentecost still falls on sons and daughters who dare to ask.
descriptions.JEIM1018CS: Climb Calvary's hill, drink from the wells of salvation, and hear three words that settle everything: it is finished.
descriptions.JEIM1018EN: Rahab's scarlet cord, the wells of salvation and an empty tomb all sing of one great exchange: His righteousness for your sin.
descriptions.JEIM1018RO: Go down into the baptism waters and up to the communion table, singing of the cross that drew you and the tomb that couldn't hold Him.
descriptions.JEIM1019EN: A long, long table is set, the empty chairs already have names on them, and the King who knew yours first is holding your seat.
descriptions.JEIM1019RO: Come home from the far country to a feast where bread is broken in every tongue and the Bride stands ready in white linen.
descriptions.JEIM1020EN: Your feet will forget the pew: a Tuesday hallelujah, a dance that outlived the funeral, and a joy the enemy simply can't stand.
descriptions.JEIM1020RO: Joy under pressure is still joy: practise it quietly, shout it on a Tuesday, and keep dancing long after grief tried to end the song.
descriptions.JEIM1021BG: The hands that hold the scepter still carry the nail marks, and that wounded King reigns higher than every storm and headline.
descriptions.JEIM1021EN: Look past the headlines to a throne with a cross on it, where the Lamb who served and bled now speaks peace to your storm.
descriptions.JEIM1021RO: Crown of thorns, crown of gold: kneel before a Servant King whose name has already bowed the storm you are standing in.
descriptions.JEIM1022EL: Hear 'Holy, holy, holy' rise in Greek, the language of John's own vision, as heaven's door opens and crowns fall at His feet.
descriptions.JEIM1022EN: Come up through the open door, where only the Lamb can open the scroll, and leave with a new song in your mouth.
descriptions.JEIM1022RU: Stand beside the river flowing from the throne in a city that needs no sun, and let the elders' falling crowns teach you to worship.
descriptions.JEIM1023EN: Stop fighting for a win already bought: the cross was the victory, the empty tomb is the receipt, and your chains are already broken.
descriptions.JEIM1024BG: Death lost the door the morning the stone rolled, so tell it on the hill and carry resurrection courage into whatever you face.
descriptions.JEIM1024EL: Christ is risen, sung in the language the Gospels were written in: an empty grave, an ascended King and a hope that never ends.
descriptions.JEIM1024EN: He walked out of the grave on His own feet, the universe is singing back, and every power that ever scared you has to bow.
descriptions.JEIM1024RO: Answer the old Easter greeting with your whole life: the stone has rolled, the King sits in glory, and His kingdom will never end.
descriptions.JEIM1025EN: Lift the cup Jesus poured and hear the promise Jeremiah ached for come true: the veil torn and God's law written on your heart.
descriptions.JEIM1026EN: The scepter is extended, so approach the throne of grace boldly, wrapped in a royal robe of righteousness you did not earn.
descriptions.JEIM1027EN: Hear the ram's horn sound: debts cancelled, land returned, chains left on the auction block, and a year of favor that never closes.
descriptions.JEIM1028EN: Breathe easy: the throne is settled, mountains step aside, and in the quiet after the storm God's still small voice anchors your soul.
descriptions.JEIM1029EN: Keep your lamp burning through the night watch, because the clouds will have feet, the dust will wake, and supper is ready.
descriptions.JEIM1029RO: Every eye will see Him, so put on clean linen, stay awake with the One who asked His friends to watch, and meet Him in the air.
descriptions.JEIM1030EN: Dreadful and glorious, the Day comes like a thief, yet for those who fear His name the Sun of Righteousness rises with healing wings.
descriptions.JEIM1030RO: All creation groans and waits for a quiet dawn when the heavens roll up like a scroll and a new earth begins that will never end.
descriptions.JEIM1031EN: Liberty is proclaimed tonight: the Healer binds up broken hearts, debts are forgiven, and every captive gets to walk out the gate.
descriptions.JEIM1032EN: Sit in heaven's half hour of silence until it breaks open and the slain Lamb is crowned, and let that awe steady your heart.
descriptions.JEIM1032LA: Ancient Latin meets the throne room: hear elders cast down golden crowns and cry 'Dignus est Agnus' to the Lamb who conquered.
descriptions.JEIM1032RU: Kneel with the heavenly host as every tribe and tongue lays pure gold at the feet of the slain Lamb who reigns forever.
descriptions.JEIM1033EN: Picture swords beaten into plowshares and the wolf lying down with the lamb, and let the coming reign of Christ quiet your heart today.
descriptions.JEIM1034EN: David's old harp strings sound again for his greater Son, whose kingdom has no end and whose shoulders carry the weight you can't.
descriptions.JEIM1035EN: Turn toward home and see the Father running, a ring and robe in His hands and a plate still warm on the table for you.
descriptions.JEIM1035RO: Adoption is sealed and the family restored: whatever you left behind, the Father's arms are open and the homecoming dance has started.
descriptions.JEIM1036EN: Tears sown in exile come back as sheaves of joy, the walls go up again, and children play in the streets of a city God has comforted.
descriptions.JEIM1036RO: Comfort, comfort: the watchmen keep praying, the gates are thrown open, and the ruins you mourned become streets full of dancing.
descriptions.JEIM1037EN: Hear God rename you Hephzibah, His delight, and cross Jordan singing a beloved 1876 hymn into a land where you are never left alone.
descriptions.JEIM1037RO: A pilgrim's longing for home: the Jordan waters stand still, the New Jerusalem comes down as a bride, and God delights in you.
descriptions.JEIM1038EN: Sit with Jesus where every tear is wiped away, death is no more, and the Tree of Life lost in Eden is growing again for you.
descriptions.JEIM1039EN: Put on the wedding garment: a quiet seat is reserved for you at the King's table, and the wine at this feast will never run out.
descriptions.JEIM1039RO: Blessed are the called: guests stream in from east and west to a banquet of rich food, under a banner over you that reads love.
descriptions.JEIM1040EN: The crown goes back at His feet where it belongs, and every generation is invited to sing Jesus King forever.
descriptions.JEIM1041EN: Ask, and wisdom is given: come near the sapphire throne and find every hidden treasure you need for tomorrow waiting in Christ.
descriptions.JEIM1042EN: Pray over your coffee cup or through a hospital window, and wake to mercies that arrived before you did, as sure as manna and sunrise.
descriptions.JEIM1042RO: Pour the coffee and pray: the God who kept you through the night already has fresh mercy waiting at sunrise.
descriptions.JEIM1043EN: Pharaoh is in the rearview and the water stands up like walls: grab Miriam's tambourine and walk out free.
descriptions.JEIM1043RO: Stand still and watch the impossible become a doorway, then dance on dry ground with a whole nation set free.
descriptions.JEIM1044EN: Out of the miry pit and onto the porch: hear a mother's prayer come true and feel the joy of salvation return.
descriptions.JEIM1044RO: Paid for with blood, not silver: draw living water from deep wells and learn that lament can end in a shout.
descriptions.JEIM1045EN: Wanderers, prisoners, the sick and the storm-tossed all came home, so open your mouth and let your gratitude ring.
descriptions.JEIM1045RO: Enter His gates with a joyful noise and tell your rescue story, because the redeemed of the Lord were made to say so.
descriptions.JEIM1046EN: Twenty-six times Psalm 136 says it, and here it lands for you: mercy stubborn enough to outlast your every no.
descriptions.JEIM1046RO: Manna on the floor, a sea pulled apart, a Father who loved you while you were gone: this love never walks away.
descriptions.JEIM1047EN: Sow your salt tears and wake up laughing like a dreamer, as the pit you fell into becomes your pulpit.
descriptions.JEIM1047RO: He reaches right into the hole you're in, and the captive's long climb ends in dancing and a mouth full of laughter.
descriptions.JEIM1048EN: The One who names every star still stoops to notice you: feel your worries shrink under a sky full of His glory.
descriptions.JEIM1049EN: Cedars clapping, whales singing, storms carrying His voice: step outside and hear God preach without a single word.
descriptions.JEIM1050EN: Running on empty, a tambourine on the kitchen tile and the joy of the Lord will carry what you can't.
descriptions.JEIM1050RO: From the Water Gate to the fiery furnace, praise becomes your dance floor and holy laughter finds you again by morning.
descriptions.JEIM1051EN: For every year the locusts ate, God promises repayment larger than the loss, and a face that is never ashamed again.
descriptions.JEIM1051RO: Count the lost seasons with the prophet Joel and watch God restore them, until survivors sit down to feast and praise.
descriptions.JEIM1052EN: Holy, Holy, Holy and Be Thou My Vision rise with a new heartbeat, carrying your praise from sunrise to sunset.
descriptions.JEIM1052RO: Sing the hymns your grandparents loved with fresh fire, and let His name fill your day from dawn until the sun goes down.
descriptions.JEIM1053EN: Heaven leaned down to listen: from years of crying to Maria's boy walking home, discover that your prayers are heard.
descriptions.JEIM1053RO: Keep calling out, because the God who dried a mother's tears and delivered her soul from death still bends down to hear.
descriptions.JEIM1054EN: Barns that can't hold the harvest, rain on the wheat, a table already set: open your hands and trust Him for today's bread.
descriptions.JEIM1054RO: Plant your tears, bring the first sheaf, and taste manna that points to Christ, the Bread who meets you every single day.
