descriptions.JEIM1055EN: Lightning owns the sky and mountains melt like wax: clap your hands, lift your head, and shout because the King reigns now.
descriptions.JEIM1056EN: Reach for the hem of His robe and let an old hymn breathe new life, until your scar becomes a story of the Healer's mercy.
descriptions.JEIM1056RO: Cry out through the long night and meet the morning at Bethesda, with comfort enough to pass down the pew.
descriptions.JEIM1057EN: Even the sparrow found a home near His altar: trade a thousand days elsewhere for one day in the courts of His presence.
descriptions.JEIM1057RO: Walk through the valley of weeping and watch it turn to springs, as you go from strength to strength into God's presence.
descriptions.JEIM1058EN: From a 3 AM bathroom floor to looking up again: tear up the ledger, set down the heavy, and hear yourself forgiven out loud.
descriptions.JEIM1058RO: The blood speaks a better word than your shame, so lay down the hidden weight and let God create a clean heart in you.
descriptions.JEIM1059EN: Be still under His feathers as Rock of Ages and A Mighty Fortress stand guard, and let a thousand fears fall at your side.
descriptions.JEIM1059RO: Trouble all around, yet the old rugged cross still stands: shelter in the secret place of the Most High, where angels keep watch.
descriptions.JEIM1060EN: The old has passed away before the dishes are done: rise with Christ, no longer a slave, and walk into brand new mercy today.
descriptions.JEIM1060RO: Behold, all things are new: leave your past in the waters of baptism and live as a daughter of the promise.
descriptions.JEIM1061EN: Sit with grief at a father's bedside and hear the trumpet answer: the sting is gone, and a wedding feast is already set.
descriptions.JEIM1061RO: Where is death's sting now: sing How Great Thou Art toward the reunion that comes in the twinkling of an eye.
descriptions.JEIM1062EN: Look up and lift your head: the fig tree is budding, the trumpet is ready, and the white horse Rider is coming for His bride.
descriptions.JEIM1063EN: The curtain tore from top to bottom, so walk boldly into the holy place and meet God face to face, no longer kept outside.
descriptions.JEIM1063RO: Heaven's door has no curtain now: by the blood of Jesus, come near with lifted hands and be changed from glory to glory.
descriptions.JEIM1064EN: Rooted by streams that never run dry, you can bear fruit in every season, still green and growing when your hair turns grey.
descriptions.JEIM1064RO: Planted in His house and fed by His river, stand tall as an oak of righteousness with a joy that outlasts the drought.
descriptions.JEIM1065EN: Hush the house for a mother's lullaby in a borrowed stable, then run with the shepherds when heaven splits the sky with glory.
descriptions.JEIM1066EN: Face the 3 AM mirror with the Refiner beside you: He found you, He is shaping you, and He will finish what He started.
descriptions.JEIM1067EN: Bring your bills and money fears to the God who provides, and discover the freedom of a giver who flows like a river, not a dam.
descriptions.JEIM1067RO: Seek His kingdom first and feel worry about money loosen its grip, as you learn to steward every blessing with open hands.
descriptions.JEIM1068EN: Blood on the doorpost, a cup of covenant, three nails and an empty tomb: follow the Lamb from Egypt's night to heaven's throne.
descriptions.JEIM1068RO: Kneel in Gethsemane, stand beneath the crown of thorns, and rise shouting Worthy is the Lamb who became the conquering Lion.
descriptions.JEIM1069EN: The King is at the door and the chains are already off, so get loud, get free, and dance like the victory is won.
descriptions.JEIM1069HI: Every tribe and tongue joins the celebration, here in Hindi, dancing because Jesus is the reason and the King is coming back.
descriptions.JEIM1069RO: Cântă acum: the kairos hour has struck, heaven hears every shout, and the dance floor is open for everyone set free.
descriptions.JEIM1070EN: Get smaller so Jesus gets louder, then save a seat for your neighbour, until heaven runs out of room one name at a time.
descriptions.JEIM1071EN: Climb onto Abba's lap and meet the Father who runs to you, closer than your breath and carrying you even when you couldn't see.
descriptions.JEIM1071HI: Pita Ka Din Mubarak to the Father of lights, who runs to meet His children and carries them when they cannot see the way.
descriptions.JEIM1071JA: Honour the Father above every father, whose good gifts never run out and whose lap is the safest place in the universe.
descriptions.JEIM1071RO: Anyone who ever missed a dad's embrace can come home: the Father of all creation runs to you, holds you close and carries you.
descriptions.JEIM1072EN: When the what-ifs bark at midnight, Jesus gets louder: let His peace sit the storm down and guard your heart until sunrise.
descriptions.JEIM1073EN: Put the phone face-down and hear the name God spoke over you before anyone could like, follow or forget it: My Delight.
descriptions.JEIM1074EN: Lonely at the kitchen sink tonight, you are not singing alone: Jesus fills the empty chair and sets the solitary in a family.
descriptions.JEIM1075EN: Drop the heavy load at the door, kick off your shoes on holy ground, and stomp a barefoot reel to the easy yoke of Jesus.
descriptions.JEIM1076EN: Bring your doubts into the room and wrestle till dawn like Jacob, then clap with Thomas: my Lord and my God.
descriptions.JEIM1077EN: The Father sprinted before you finished saying sorry: the porch light is on, confetti is falling, and shame isn't on the list.
descriptions.JEIM1077RO: Case dismissed, robe and ring restored: fall seven times, rise again every time, and walk through a door that never closes.
descriptions.JEIM1078EN: Your assignment was written before your résumé: rise from the kitchen floor and march in step with the God who sends you.
descriptions.JEIM1079EN: Leave your jar at the well and meet the One who knows everything you ever did and wants you anyway.
descriptions.JEIM1080EN: Through the emptied room and the worst night, one refrain holds: His steadfast love never leaves, sung by every nation.
descriptions.JEIM1081EN: Chained at midnight like Paul and Silas, sing anyway, and watch every torn-up piece of bad news fall as confetti.
descriptions.JEIM1082EN: Throw open the doors and tarry: the Spirit who hovered over the deep still comes to fill the empty folding chairs.
descriptions.JEIM1083EN: One word from Yeshua healed across a whole town: stand with Bartimaeus and the woman at the hem, and hear mercy call your name.
descriptions.JEIM1084EN: The scroll is open and the jubilee horn is sounding: hear Yeshua proclaim liberty over your debts, your weights and your graves.
descriptions.JMZM1001EN: Turn the kitchen into a dance floor and the Sunday drive into a shout: arise, shine, and dance for the coming King of Kings.
descriptions.JMZM1002EN: Come thirsty and leave overflowing, as the fountain opens and rivers from the throne carry you into salvation's flow.
descriptions.JMZM1003EN: Walk out of the fire whole, standing on promises no storm can crack, with a Savior who has made you new.
descriptions.JMZM1004EN: Build the altar, strike the flame and give your whole life back as a living sacrifice, set ablaze with shouts of praise.
descriptions.JMZM1005EN: The God who remembers you are dust has hidden treasure in your jar of clay, and He is lifting you off every dusty road.
descriptions.JMZM1006EN: Come home: the door is flung open, a place is already prepared with your name on it, and Jesus is waiting to welcome you in.
descriptions.JMZM1007EN: Wake to fresh bread from heaven every morning and gather just enough grace for today from the Savior who feeds you.
descriptions.JMZM1008EN: Step into the Holy of Holies and find a refuge so close you can carry it with you all week long.
descriptions.JMZM1009EN: Lift up your heads, O gates: the King is at the door, and every heartbeat of waiting leans toward the day we cross over.
descriptions.JMZM1010EN: Take the good news to every street without flinching, with testimony anthems that put fire in your voice and courage in your step.
descriptions.JMZM1011EN: Chosen, beloved and totally in love: the Church gets ready for a royal wedding with Jesus waiting as her Groom.
descriptions.JMZM1012EN: Lost in the wilderness and deceived by the serpent's whisper, the Church is rescued by her Bridegroom and walked down heaven's aisle.
descriptions.JMZM1012RO: Heaven's love story sung in Romanian: a lonely Church in the wilderness, and the Bridegroom who comes all the way to claim her.
descriptions.JMZM1013EN: Hear how Jesus sees you: washed without spot or wrinkle, made lovely by grace and given a crown of beauty.
descriptions.JMZM1014EN: Pull up a chair at the Father's table, where every seat is filled and the marriage supper of the Lamb is almost ready.
descriptions.JMZM1015EN: Betrothed forever and sealed in blood, rest in a love that will not let you go and never, ever fails.
descriptions.JMZM1016EN: Before the world was made, He picked you out by name: stand tall in a royal priesthood and dance like you belong.
descriptions.JMZM1017EN: All heaven is watching as the vows are spoken and two become one: rehearse the wedding of eternity right where you stand.
descriptions.JMZM1018EN: Trade a tepid faith for a heart set ablaze with a love strong as death, and dance with abandon for the King of your heart.
descriptions.JMZM1019EN: The King's daughter walks in gold of Ophir: lift your head and take your seat as royalty beside the One who crowned you.
descriptions.JMZM1020EN: Seated with Christ and heir to His throne, rise from defeat and learn to reign in life through the One who reigns forever.
descriptions.JMZM1021EN: Trim your lamp and put on fine linen: the aisle is waking up, and the Bridegroom is closer than midnight.
descriptions.JMZM1022EN: Awake, you who sleep: over Middle Eastern melodies the trumpet sounds, the light has come, and a drowsy Church rises to shine.
descriptions.JMZM1023EN: From the balcony to the banquet hall, taste the promise of the day Jesus lifts the cup of new wine with His people again.
descriptions.JMZM1024EN: Clothed in garments of salvation and jeweled from within, discover a beauty no mirror can show and no year can fade.
descriptions.JMZM1025EN: Nothing in death, life or height can pull you from this love, so let perfect love cast out fear while God sings over you.
descriptions.JMZM1026EN: At the midnight cry, keep oil in your lamp and joy in your heart, like a friend who thrills to hear the Bridegroom's voice.
descriptions.JMZM1027EN: Drums roll and the King Himself shouts for joy over you: dance until His joy becomes your strength.
descriptions.JMZM1028EN: Tears sown in the night come back as a harvest of joy by morning, sung with island warmth that turns mourning into dancing.
descriptions.JMZM1029EN: Clap your hands, all you peoples: the Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God and worthy Lamb deserves every shout you've been saving.
descriptions.JMZM1030EN: Island breezes carry the invitation: the table is spread, the finest wine is poured, and there's room at the banquet for you.
descriptions.JMZM1031EN: Before you ever loved Him, He called you His delight: gentle folk melodies for resting in being His, and He yours.
descriptions.JMZM1032EN: Hold on through the hard stretch: those who endure will reign, made a kingdom of priests who shine on the earth forever.
descriptions.JMZM1033EN: Picture a thousand years when the wolf lies down with the lamb and the Lord is King over all the earth, and let that hope hold you.
descriptions.JMZM1034EN: Born for such a time as this, rise like Esther, overcome, and take your promised seat with Christ on His throne.
descriptions.JMZM1035EN: Search the midnight streets for the One your soul loves and find He already knows you, holds you and lives in you.
descriptions.JMZM1036EN: Guitars roar toward a new heaven and earth, where we are changed in a flash and belong to a kingdom nothing can shake.
descriptions.JMZM1037EN: Every pilgrim step on the Highway of Holiness brings you nearer to a Father already running down the road to meet you.
descriptions.JMZM1038EN: Hear the King singing over you, and find the new song only your once-silent voice was made to sing back.
descriptions.JMZM1039EN: Nothing in life or death can pry you loose from His hand: rest in a love that has already prepared a room for you.
descriptions.JMZM1040EN: Every tribe and tongue is already dancing at the wedding, and the Spirit and the Bride are calling you in with one word: come.
descriptions.JMZM1041EN: If the disciples fall silent the stones will shout, and from Tokyo to Lagos even silicon finds its voice to praise Jesus.
descriptions.MDIM1001EN: Crack a shut-up heart open just one inch and let the light, the laughter and the little kindnesses back in.
descriptions.MDIM1002EN: Love you hear before you see it, loud enough to rattle golden cages and far too honest to stay a secret.
descriptions.MDIM1002HI: Garaj-sa Pyaar: friends who stay, family who cross three cities, and a phone that keeps ringing until you know you're loved.
descriptions.MDIM1003EN: Forever turns out to be a Wednesday in the grocery aisle, and choosing each other again becomes the sweetest romance.
descriptions.MDIM1004EN: Unzip the costume you outgrew and step out as the one you always were: made, not made-up, and never lost, only loved.
descriptions.MDIM1005EN: Tank on empty and legs giving out: slide into the passenger seat and let love carry you all the way to the porch light.
descriptions.MDIM1005RO: Du-mă acasă: a 2 AM call answered, mama's arms, a soft place to land, and a light by the door that never went out.
descriptions.MDIM1006EN: Leave the voice memo running, say the words you couldn't, and discover somebody was hearing you all along.
descriptions.MDIM1007EN: Nobody switched you on: step out of the shade and glow with a light that was warm inside you before the dawn.
descriptions.MDIM1008EN: Coffee on a Tuesday, a sister's laugh, a dog who knew: slow down and catch the miracles hiding in your everyday.
descriptions.MDIM1008RO: Banjo-bright wonder in Romanian: count kind strangers and backyard sunsets until you're singing aleluia from the porch.
descriptions.MDIM1009EN: Pull the swallowed question out of your throat and shout it, and find that "I don't know yet" is a brave place to stand.
descriptions.MDIM1010EN: Same lot, new drawing: pour a fresh foundation after the collapse and build a life with a door held open for the next one.
descriptions.MDIM1011EN: No matter how late or how lost, pull in slow: the door's unlocked, grandma's kitchen is warm and you were expected.
descriptions.MDIM1012EN: Got out of bed, drank the water, answered the text: throw confetti for every small victory and let your joy catch up.
descriptions.MDIM1013EN: Grab a concrete step, a plate from next door and the bongos on the block, because on this street nobody eats alone.
descriptions.MDIM1014EN: Your receipts tell the truth about your heart, and this warm nudge will have you spending like you love your people.
descriptions.MDIM1015EN: Slide into booth three with a friend who listens without fixing, and walk home lighter than you came.
descriptions.MDIM1016EN: Read the warning label: better sleep, a call to Mom, a stranger helped, and a smile you won't be able to shake.
descriptions.MDIM1017EN: Skip the mountain and the vow: say the thing, ask for help, walk in, and let one brave second at a time change your year.
descriptions.MDIM1018EN: Phone face down, slow coffee, a walk with no map: reclaim a day that belongs to you and return to the week restored.
descriptions.MDIM1019EN: A sticking closet door, a crooked window and your name on the lease: a tender goodbye to the first four walls that were yours.
descriptions.MDIM1020EN: Split the bills to the cent and share everything else whole, a joyful toast to roommates who became family by choice.
descriptions.MDIM1021EN: When the feeling is too big for language, stop searching and start moving, and trust your heartbeat to name it tomorrow.
descriptions.MDIM1022EN: Hospital glow, empty highways, coffee at two: honor the night-shift heroes and the friends who pick up in nine seconds flat.
descriptions.MDIM1023EN: No spark, no spotlight, just the quiet doing: find the holy in packing a lunch and turning up when nobody's watching.
descriptions.MDIM1024EN: He remembered your order and your pulse filed the news before you did: relive the giddy first flutter of falling for someone.
descriptions.MDIM1025EN: Popsicles melting, notes folded twelve ways, the whole friend group in on it: pure sunny delight in a brand new crush.
descriptions.MDIM1026EN: Soup at the door, a call at three and truth spoken in love: celebrate the friends who stayed when you were hard to hold.
descriptions.MDIM1027EN: Stop apologizing for the skin you're in: you're not a rough draft, and tonight you get to stay and like who you see.
descriptions.MDIM1028EN: Send the application, take the meeting, raise your hand high, and find the nerve to say yes at full size.
descriptions.MDIM1029EN: Day 47 sober, a grocery-store cry, the alarm set again: strength for the ordinary days that carry weight without applause.
descriptions.MDIM1030EN: Take the dream off the napkin and say it at a volume you can't walk back, because every no is just a map.
descriptions.MDIM1031EN: Birthday crowns, graduation tassels, a conga line at abuela's: every scrap on the floor is a joy worth remembering.
descriptions.MDIM1032EN: Kitchen floor, hallway strut, red-light bounce: shake off the week and let your whole body say yes until the sun comes up.
descriptions.MDIM1033EN: Feel the wind, taste the first warm day and grab joy with both hands, because you are no passenger in your own life.
descriptions.MDIM1034EN: Flip-flops, mango skies and abuela's cooler bag: a reggae-kissed block party where the downbeat is the sun.
descriptions.MDIM1035EN: Walk out whole, forgive and keep driving: freedom after heartbreak that fits like a coat one season older, no bitterness packed.
descriptions.MDIM1036EN: Shake out the shoebox of cousin summers and grandma's garden, and feel grateful for every face that made it into the frame.
descriptions.MDIM1037EN: Church bells at six, tortillas on the table, the same crooked sign: go home again and whisper gracias a Dios for how you've grown.
descriptions.MDIM1038EN: First paycheck, half a tank and llaves en la mano: taste the thrill and the weight of freedom as you drive toward sunrise.
descriptions.MDIM1039EN: Take the seat by the glass above the clouds, through mountains and into new cities, and fall back in love with wonder.
descriptions.MDIM1040EN: Up before dawn laying one brick at a time, find a hope you can build with your hands and a future that is faithful.
descriptions.MDIM1041EN: Stop hinting and say the actual sentence: permission to ask for love out loud, and the joy of finally hearing it back.
descriptions.MDIM1042EN: Not a leaf on a river or the last one in line: step off the sidelines of your own story and own the choices only you can make.
descriptions.MDIM1043EN: Put the alarm across the room so you have to stand to stop it: get moving first, and watch the hunger for your dream follow.
descriptions.MDIM1044EN: A fan, an ice cube, fridge light on the wall and a kiss: fall in love with the unfiltered present and be glad you're in it.
descriptions.MDIM1045EN: Nineteen years of never having to explain: a salute to the friends who pick up mid-sentence like no time passed at all.
descriptions.MDIM1046EN: Release one small kindness on an ordinary afternoon and trust it to keep working far beyond where you'll ever see.
descriptions.MDIM1047EN: Rubber, not glass: hit the same floor on the same cold night and rise quicker, stronger and surer of your footing.
descriptions.MDIM1048EN: Holding your breath since the eight o'clock alarm, exhale all the way and let the floor come up to meet you tonight.
descriptions.MDIM1049EN: Nothing to fix, nothing to prove, nothing to explain: rest in a good-enough day and discover okay is a place you can live.
descriptions.MDIM1050EN: There was never a batch, only you: they broke the mould and lost the pieces, so walk tall in a shape made once.
descriptions.MDIM1051EN: Capable and terrified at the same time, step forward ready before you feel it and let courage catch up with your hands.
descriptions.MDIM1052EN: Write the first line of the night with your feet, spend the joy you've saved since December and make a memory worth keeping.
descriptions.MDIM1053EN: Two more minutes of daylight than yesterday: not bright yet, but brighter, and hope enough to carry you through tonight.
descriptions.MDIM1054EN: Bread at four forty, diesel at five, the whole cuadra already awake: feel held by a town that was up loving you before you rose.
descriptions.MDIM1055EN: Don't shake it, just wait: like a photo developing, the summers you lived come slowly into focus and bring the faces back.
descriptions.MDIM1056EN: Same road, same wind, every reason to fold: stay open to life, not because it's safe but because that is who you are.
descriptions.MDIM1057EN: Strangers one minute, one body the next: hands up, boards shaking, find belonging in a crowd lifted by the same beat.
descriptions.MDIM1058EN: Two forgotten quarters in last year's coat: learn to grin at small, useless wonders and welcome fall like an old friend.
descriptions.MDIM1059EN: Timer on the counter, ring light two feet away: honor both the hustle and the shine without choosing which one is really you.
descriptions.MDIM1060EN: A far-away number you could dial half asleep: love that counts the miles as the length of us, never the defeat.
descriptions.MDIM1061EN: Last cup at the kitchen table, four chairs and a kettle: savor every sound before you go, and carry home down the road.
descriptions.MDIM1062EN: The napkin math says no and you go anyway: courage that hears the odds honestly and still steps out in faith.
descriptions.MDIM1063EN: You get the morning, they get the moon: comfort for loved ones split by time zones, still sharing one sky and one star.
descriptions.MDIM1064EN: No straight line and no shortcut: learn to love the bends in your road, because the winding route still brings you home.
descriptions.MDIM1065EN: Calloused palms that sanded the world soft for you: a thankful tribute to the parents who built the floor you dance on.
descriptions.MDIM1066EN: Not a heartbreak, just a door left at an interesting angle: smile back at the near-romance that taught your heart to hope.
descriptions.MDIM1067EN: A hairline crack in the lamppost from when you were ten: come back to the block and feel known by the place that raised you.
descriptions.MDIM1068EN: Same door, second time, walking in with open eyes: courage to start over when you already know the cost and choose it anyway.
descriptions.MDIM1069EN: You're not a typo: quit apologizing for your quirks and show up early to the one-of-a-kind life you were made for.
descriptions.MDIM1070EN: Nine sleeps to go: dance through every dark night for the one you miss, knowing each brings their face a day nearer.
descriptions.MDIM1071EN: Crank the knob to the right and leave it there: chipped paint underfoot, your whole voice in the air, nothing held back.
descriptions.MDIM1072EN: Shrug off the heavy wool coat of a grudge and feel the hallway widen as your hands go warm again.
descriptions.MDIM1073EN: Grab the side with no handle: a grit-and-sweat anthem for people who take the harder corner so someone else carries less.
descriptions.MDIM1074EN: Wet grass, a jar in one hand and a lid in the other: rediscover the wonder that still leaps when the first light blinks.
descriptions.MDIM1075EN: The maple never waited until you were ready, so learn to bend with grace when change shows up at the door unannounced.
descriptions.MDIM1076EN: Let them keep the zip code and the key: find a belonging that travels with you wherever love takes your feet.
descriptions.MDIM1077EN: Sleepless and sketching tomorrow: hip-hop fuel for dreamers drawing up big plans while the rest of the house is asleep.
descriptions.MDIM1078EN: Fourteen months, one grid, a marker out of ink: celebrate the finish line with every name who helped you cross it.
descriptions.MDIM1079EN: Down at the half with a whole half left to play: halftime courage for anyone staring at a scoreboard that isn't final yet.
descriptions.MDIM1080EN: Before you knew yourself, you were already known: rest in the One who read your story before the world could tell it.
descriptions.MDIM1081EN: Hand Jesus every ping, every spin and every sleepless fight, then close your eyes while He holds the night.
descriptions.MDIM1082EN: Trade the caption you keep rewriting for the story God already penned about you, and sing it with gospel joy.
descriptions.MDIM1083EN: Never walk into a room alone again: Jesus calls you friend, not servant, and stays at your side through every doorway.
descriptions.MDIM1084EN: Set your striving to auto-reply with no forwarding address and answer Jesus' invitation: come, weary one, and rest.
descriptions.MDIM1085EN: Ask them laughing, ask them crying: every question you carry runs down the same road to one jazz-warm Answer, Jesus.
descriptions.MDIM1086EN: Come home wrecked and find your cup still at the table, your name never crossed out, and a welcome planned long ago.
descriptions.MDIM1088EN: Let every pixel of pretending fall out of view and drink living water from the only One who never needs a filter.
descriptions.MDIM1089EN: Every prayer you ever sent up was heard, not left hanging: dance in the joy of a Savior who always writes back.
descriptions.MDIM1090EN: Throw the paper into the dark before the trouble even leaves the room, because Jesus already won and keeps His word.
descriptions.MDIM1091HI: Shahar Jaag Gaya: rise with a whole city stirring awake and greet the morning with a fresh, bright heart.
descriptions.NVIM1001EN: The tremor came back after you thought you were past it: meet the Jesus who holds the floor and won't leave you in the rubble.
descriptions.NVIM1002EN: Older than the books we carry, a kindness that moves like Jesus: pull up to a wide table where care comes before any words.
descriptions.NVIM1003EN: The silence you tucked beneath the pew was heard all along: find the courage to name what happened and claim your voice as yours.
descriptions.NVIM1004EN: Hand Jesus the drought-sealed field of your heart and let His plow turn hard dust into rows where green shoots rise.
descriptions.NVIM1005EN: The empty chair, the casserole dish, the kitchen gone quiet: grieve with Jesus and find that grief is love still carrying them.
descriptions.NVIM1005UK: In Ukrainian, Ponesu Yikh Dodomu sits with you in the hush of an empty kitchen and turns the loudest absence into prayer.
descriptions.NVIM1006EN: Take the cellar stairs with Christ beside you, let your eyes adjust to the dark, and watch the buried room become a chapel.
descriptions.NVIM1007EN: The porch light is still burning: walk the long road home unafraid and let the Father restore the years you thought were lost.
descriptions.NVIM1007HI: Puri Hokar Lautna walks the prodigal's road in Hindi: every step a prayer, lost years restored, and a lamp still lit at home.
descriptions.NVIM1007SV: Laugh again, walk past the old house and sing the song you'd dropped, all the way home in Swedish to a Father's porch light.
descriptions.NVIM1008EN: You can't turn back the clock, but grace can soften the stone of wasted years and turn your face toward a redemption arc.
descriptions.NVIM1009EN: There's still a coal beneath the ash: let God's breath fan a faded faith into a slow burn, then a beacon you can pass on.
descriptions.NVIM1010EN: Stop hiding the scar: the mark you carry can become proof that mercy came, touched by the One wounded for you.
descriptions.NVIM1011EN: Bring the questions the chapel couldn't hold and meet a God who pulls up a second chair and says, ask Me anything.
descriptions.NVIM1012EN: Three dots that never became words: hold your unfinished goodbye beside a God who lost a Son too.
descriptions.NVIM1013EN: A bench, a breath, a bowed head: build a small room the noise can't find and learn to hear God when you finally stop.
descriptions.NVIM1013FI: Kuuntelun paikka clears a hushed Finnish room with a bench and a slow breath, where the noise can't follow you in.
descriptions.NVIM1013JA: Sit at the threshold, breathe a prayer, hear the hour bell: a Japanese garden of stillness that teaches your heart to listen.
descriptions.NVIM1014EN: For the year you couldn't pray: one candle, one honest how long, and the slow discovery that the silence was speaking.
descriptions.NVIM1015EN: Before you ever heard the knock, the Shepherd was already crossing the long field toward your darkest hour.
descriptions.NVIM1016EN: That small blue square still saying their name: hold a loved voice close while the Spirit speaks softly into a sleeping house.
descriptions.NVIM1017EN: From Iona at dawn to the kitchen sink and a hospice bedside, find the places where heaven leans close enough to touch.
descriptions.NVIM1017JA: Usuki Basho carries you from a headland chapel to a hospice room in Japanese, where the veil trembles and heaven comes down.
descriptions.NVIM1017NO: Tynne steder brings Celtic wonder into Norwegian song, where the veil turns clear as glass and the whole earth is God's country.
descriptions.NVIM1018EN: Vinyl chairs, vending machine coffee, hour six: find steady ground under the linoleum and a God who sits with you while you wait.
descriptions.NVIM1019EN: When the news splits the calendar in two, hear the quiet voice underneath the syllables: fear not, I am with you.
descriptions.NVIM1020EN: Step into the room next to faith, where there's no lock on the latch and honest questions can sit beside your worship.
descriptions.NVIM1021EN: Reach for the hem in the crowd and hear a weeping valley fill with His name as the Healer walks the hills tonight.
descriptions.NVIM1022EN: Pulled from the water and sprung from the cell, feel every bell inside you swinging hallelujah till forever.
descriptions.NVIM1023EN: Clap your hands for the Physician of Nazareth, who walks the village lanes and calls the hurting by name.
descriptions.NVIM1024BN: Clap and lift your head in Bengali praise for the Good Shepherd of Galilee, who searches the hedges until the lost one is fed.
descriptions.NVIM1024EN: Psalm 23 out loud: still water, a table in the open field, and goodness and mercy chasing you all the way home.
descriptions.NVIM1024NL: Sing Psalm 23 aloud in Dutch with Celtic joy, and know the Shepherd keeps searching until the hundredth sheep is home.
descriptions.NVIM1024RO: In Romanian, the Good Shepherd breaks through the hedge for the one lost sheep and walks you through the valley with His staff.
descriptions.NVIM1025EN: Taste and see that He is good, then find that goodness waiting in the doorway, quieting the loop, and chasing you down.
descriptions.NVIM1026EN: The Prince walks in and the war finds release: carry a peace that makes no sense into the room you were afraid of.
descriptions.NVIM1026MS: Raja Damai brings the Prince of Peace into Malay gospel, where the fighting stills and Sar Shalom is nearer than home.
descriptions.NVIM1026TH: Open the door to the Prince of Peace in Thai worship and find a calm that knows your name, nearer than your very breath.
descriptions.NVIM1027EN: You don't have to run: perfect love walks toward you, walks the fear out of the room, and stays when you stop earning it.
descriptions.NVIM1028EN: Hands up, hearts open, in a field hospital with hymns where the whole room rises together and carries it to the street.
descriptions.NVIM1029EN: The kettle sings, the table is set wide, and Jesus walks into every room of your household to break old chains down the bloodline.
descriptions.NVIM1029UK: Throw open the door in Ukrainian worship with a bluegrass heart, where Jesus sits at your table and every room blooms again.
descriptions.NVIM1030EN: Follow the river from the throne across every border, refugee road and hidden church to a feast set for all the earth.
descriptions.NVIM1031EN: However long the dark has lasted, it cannot put out the Lamp, the Word and the Dawn who is shining through right now.
descriptions.NVIM1031TH: In Thai electronic worship, carry the lamp from the long night's hallway into a morning kitchen where light always wins.
descriptions.NVIM1032EN: Before the mountains were measured, He was God: an ambient space to breathe slowly beneath an everlasting Father.
descriptions.NVIM1033EN: Let Christ pull the plug on the old you, then watch something brand new load where the old has been.
descriptions.NVIM1034EN: Cut through the static and tune in to the same voice the prophets heard, broadcasting over the city tonight.
descriptions.NVIM1035EN: Run through the neon and the midnight highways all you like: you will never outpace the One who runs after you.
descriptions.NVIM1036EN: Stand under the constellations and marvel that their Maker bends down to your face with such tender grace.
descriptions.NVIM1036NO: Din veldighet sets Psalm 8 to Norwegian electronica: feel small beneath the cosmos and utterly seen by its Maker.
descriptions.NVIM1036SV: Orion, the Pleiades and a sea held in its bounds: in Swedish, be dust-small yet dearly loved by the God of the galaxies.
descriptions.NVIM1037EN: The long night is not the end of your story: hold on, because the dawn is already on its way to you.
descriptions.NVIM1038EN: Let the noise go and your soul slow down: an electronic exhale into the steady, unhurried presence of God.
descriptions.NVIM1038FI: Ole hiljaa ja tieda: Finnish electronic stillness that lets the clamour fade and your soul finally catch its breath.
descriptions.NVIM1038NL: Put the phone in the drawer, listen to the kettle and rest in the boat: Dutch stillness for noise you can no longer carry.
descriptions.NVIM1038RO: Lay it down, let the kettle hum, and rest in the boat with your Maker as Romanian stillness revives your soul.
descriptions.NVIM1039EN: No dead zone is beyond His reach: however far you've drifted, the Father's love is still on the line, calling you home.
descriptions.NVIM1040EN: Parched by the glow of the city, meet Jesus waiting at the well with a cool cup that makes the desert whole.
descriptions.NVIM1041EN: Cold, dim and unlit on the shelf no more: feel the Father hold His flame to your wick until your lamp comes alive.
descriptions.NVIM1042EN: When the whole world shakes, lock into the steady beat of a Throne that doesn't move, even on the far side of death.
descriptions.NVIM1043EN: Walk the valley of dry bones and feel God's breath rush in, a God unafraid of wherever you are right now.
descriptions.NVIM1044EN: The God who counts every star hasn't lost track of you either, so look up tonight and know you are counted.
descriptions.NVIM1045EN: Break the four-bar cycle of the same sin and the same tears, and let grace open a cage you could never unlock alone.
descriptions.NVIM1046EN: The wind was loud but the Lord wasn't in it: find Him, as Elijah did, in the hush that comes after the storm.
descriptions.NVIM1047EN: Loop the truth that God's mercies are new every morning, faithful as a kick drum beneath every one of your days.
descriptions.NVIM1048EN: Cry out from the depths and wait like a watchman for morning: with God there is forgiveness, and at last, rest.
descriptions.NVIM1049EN: Silence the lie you rehearsed and hear your true name spoken by the voice that made the world.
descriptions.NVIM1050EN: The curtain still hangs, but the Lamb has set His face toward morning, and every ache of longing is about to become an open door.
descriptions.NVIM1051EN: Tune past the noise and interference in your head to the quiet frequency where God's calm comes through clear.
descriptions.NVIM1052EN: Under the city's flickering signs, discover that heaven has already written your name in lights.
descriptions.NVIM1053EN: Pipes and pulses for the long road back, where every weary step is taken with Someone right beside you.
descriptions.NVIM1054EN: Running on one percent: rest in the One who restores your soul and let Him refill what the week drained dry.
descriptions.NVIM1055EN: Linger in the Presence you never want to leave, and hear the quiet promise that He isn't going anywhere.
descriptions.NVIM1056EN: You were falling, the Father ran first, and the courtroom that should have condemned you erupts in confetti.
descriptions.NVIM1057EN: Fearfully and wonderfully made, down to the last spark: bright anthems to silence the lie that you were an accident.
descriptions.SAIM1001EN: Through the diagnosis, the lost job and the border crossing, every beat bows to a King who never once let go of your hand.
descriptions.SAIM1002EN: Bead by bead, abuela spoke your name to heaven, and those prayers are still crossing oceans to find you tonight.
descriptions.SAIM1003EN: Love that shows up in the fight: Christ walks beside you through sickness and storm, then leads you like a Bridegroom into victory.
descriptions.SAIM1004EN: Glory in the laundromat, worship in the bodega, blessing on every door: watch Jesus move onto your block and wake the whole barrio.
descriptions.SAIM1005BR: Wake up to a heart that drums for Jesus alone, from the tick of the kitchen clock to the hush of Sunday morning.
descriptions.SAIM1005EN: Every heartbeat becomes a boom-ch-boom for Christ, pulsing through your family, your quiet moments and your love for others.
descriptions.SAIM1006EN: From the plaza to the wake to the border, the Cross leads a resurrection cumbia that lifts whole villages to their feet.
descriptions.SAIM1007EN: The Kingdom never came in a limousine: meet Jesus at the open door, the shared bread and the forgotten names the city passed by.
descriptions.SAIM1008EN: Marigolds and candles give way to resurrection light, as grief for the ones you miss turns into sure hope that in Christ they live.
descriptions.SAIM1009EN: At 3 AM in the kitchen or the hospital corridor, a bandoneón opens the window and shows you Who was standing there before you prayed.
descriptions.SAIM1010EN: Before you reach the checkpoint the Cross has already crossed, so carry courage over every river: Christ waits on the far side.
descriptions.SAIM1011EN: In the courtroom of your conscience, justice and mercy kiss at the Cross, and the verdict over the guilty becomes simply: justified.
descriptions.SAIM1012EN: Single moms, rehab Sundays, DACA vigils, the daily hustle: in every round you fight, Christ walks the block and makes it holy.
descriptions.SAIM1013EN: Mamá knelt by the stove and heaven heard, and one by one the wanderers come home until every chair at the table is full.
descriptions.SAIM1014EN: Greet each sunrise with new mercies and an open Word, and let Christ carry you from first light to evening's quiet homecoming.
descriptions.SAIM1015EN: A coming-of-age fiesta for the soul: declare your faith, go down in the water, take the mic, and step out into the world.
descriptions.SAIM1016EN: Dig past the martyrs' letters and the grandparents' table to find the living Christ who has been singing in your roots all along.
descriptions.SAIM1017EN: The band is already playing and the ring is waiting: come home to a Father who saw you from far off and ran.
descriptions.SAIM1018EN: Cristo doesn't need a translator: from abuela's stove to the WhatsApp devotional, live a faith that speaks both your languages.
descriptions.SAIM1019EN: Sing the ballad of the Carpenter who crossed from throne to manger to cross, just to carry your name over to His side.
descriptions.SAIM1020EN: When the one you love is taken away, find a Christ who sits at your emptied table and whose presence no border can remove.
descriptions.SAIM1021EN: Nazareth was a slum too: hear the voice of Christ rise from the favela rooftops until the whole city stops to listen.
descriptions.SAIM1022EN: When every other name fades, stand in the barrio street and find the one Door, the Way, the Truth and the Life, open for you.
descriptions.SAIM1022ES: Kings fall and famous names fade, but one Name still knows you by heart and holds open the only Door home.
descriptions.SAIM1022RO: Build an altar in the street: carry the Name above all names out your door, and meet the Shepherd who already knows you.
descriptions.SAIM1023EN: Grandma at dawn, parents at dinner, kids singing in the back row: gather your family around a table where Christ keeps every seat.
descriptions.SAIM1024EN: Christmas tamales, a Bible with a cracked spine, five miles walked to church: inherit a faith worn smooth by loving hands.
descriptions.SAIM1025EN: Break open your alabaster jar at His feet and linger in holy silence until adoration is all your heart has left to say.
descriptions.SAIM1025ES: Kneel with tears on His feet and every crown cast down, and let a whispered love song carry you into His presence.
descriptions.SAIM1025RO: Lean your head on His chest and rest: tender worship for the soul that longs to know Jesus, not just know about Him.
descriptions.SAIM1026EN: Three nails, a torn veil, one cry of It is finished: stand at Calvary and hear the wood declare that by His wounds you are free.
descriptions.SAIM1027EN: Mercy as wide as the sea meets you at the well, at dawn and at the prodigal's gate, then teaches you to forgive seventy times seven.
descriptions.SAIM1028EN: With Peter, Zacchaeus and the tax collector, lay down your dust and ashes and walk the road home into a brand new life.
descriptions.SAIM1029EN: Learn to pray like Hannah in the temple and Bartimaeus by the road, until daily prayer becomes the steady heartbeat of your life.
descriptions.SAIM1030EN: Feed a hungry soul from abuela's worn Bible and walk into tomorrow with the Word as your lamp, your sword and your daily bread.
descriptions.SAIM1031EN: On the Damascus road, in Mary's garden, at the Emmaus table: relive the moments Jesus found people, and let Him find you too.
descriptions.SAIM1032EN: Paul, Stephen, the martyrs and your praying grandmother cheer from the stands: fix your eyes on Jesus and run your leg of the race.
descriptions.SAIM1033EN: For tear-soaked pillows and thorns that stay: worship alongside Job and discover the Light who sits beside you in the dark.
descriptions.SAIM1034EN: You are no mistake: wear the Father's signature with no filter, crowned rather than compared in a world of endless images.
descriptions.SAIM1035EN: Pull up another chair and dance the cumbia of open hands, where sharing bread with a neighbour never means going without.
descriptions.SAIM1036BR: Stomp your feet in the praça with every tribe and tongue, because the carnival of the Lamb is a party that never ends.
descriptions.SAIM1036EN: Let everything with breath join the holy samba, where Grandma Hope dances in the plaza and the feast of the Lamb never winds down.
descriptions.SAIM1037EN: Worn boots, new faith and Christ for a compass: every river crossed and every scar tells of a pilgrim road that ends at home.
descriptions.SAIM1038EN: Banda brass, Sunday tortillas and mestizo pride all find their home in Christ, the soil where every race grows as one blood.
descriptions.SAIM1039EN: Say sí, quiero to a love that never changes: purity, calling and marriage built on Christ, marching toward the wedding of the Lamb.
descriptions.SAIM1040EN: Thank Him louder than before, in Spanish and Portuguese, for breath, for bread and for the Cross that threw open every door.
descriptions.SAIM1041EN: From abuela to grandson the same Christ keeps every promise: dance to the faithfulness that has carried your family for years.
descriptions.SAIM1042EN: Tear off every label the street pinned on you: the Father calls you son, rewrites your name and crowns you on the corner you fell.
descriptions.SAIM1043EN: Put the shovel down and watch the ledger burn: it is finished, so rest becomes your flex and freedom becomes your dance.
descriptions.SAIM1044EN: Thunder overhead, joy underfoot: step onto the water, meet the fourth Man in the fire, and dance until mourning turns to morning.
descriptions.SAIM1044HI: Joy becomes your weapon and peace your anchor when the rain won't quit, and daybreak finds you still dancing with Jesus.
descriptions.SAIM1045EN: Wave the gospel high with no shame on your face, and let the whole block see a city on a hill that cannot be hidden.
descriptions.SAIM1046EN: Rice and beans on paper plates, chairs out on the street: find the crew that carries you to Jesus when you cannot walk alone.
descriptions.SAIM1047EN: Trade the party's empty morning cup for a well that never runs dry, and feel living water spill over onto everyone around you.
descriptions.SAIM1048EN: Watch the corner cynic and the comedian drop their masks and catch a grin that won't come off: the last laugh belongs to Jesus.
descriptions.SAIM1049EN: Before your first breath God chose you and wrote your days in His book: get up from the wall you sat at and walk into your calling.
descriptions.SAIM1050EN: Slow your racing soul, hand Him the weight you have carried, and find quiet waters and Sabbath rest right in the middle of the city.
descriptions.SAIM1051EN: The dividing wall is rubble now: old enemies embrace on the dance floor, and every blood and every rhythm moves as one family.
descriptions.THIM1001EN: Long before a ship sighted shore, the Creator was already calling your people by name through wind, drum and the elders' dreams.
descriptions.THIM1002EN: For every child loaded on the train and every name hidden: a Savior who counted each one, lost no one, and gives the language back.
descriptions.THIM1003EN: Plant shade you'll never sit in: hand the next seven generations Christ, the drum and the stories that must not be hidden.
descriptions.THIM1004EN: Pull up a chair by the fire, speak the wound out loud, and hear Jesus answer with two words and a hand: I am willing.
descriptions.THIM1005EN: Somewhere the sun is already up: feel the Father's heartbeat under your own and let healing rise with mercy new every morning.
descriptions.THIM1006EN: Wrap up in her quilt, read the word she wrote in the margin, and take up the prayers a praying grandmother left for you to carry.
descriptions.THIM1007EN: He searched the culvert where you hid and spoke your name in the dark: ride home on the Shepherd's shoulders to a yard full of joy.
descriptions.THIM1008EN: The clipboard fills, the pencil wears down and still the nations keep walking in: take your place in a crowd no one can count.
descriptions.THIM1009EN: Set your trophy on the mat and your cap in your fist, and discover the bow before King Jesus that straightens you up.
descriptions.THIM1010EN: Grace for working hands and half-built lives: be washed, pruned and kept by the Carpenter until you are holy on an ordinary Tuesday.
descriptions.THIM1011EN: Walk to the garden worried about the stone, and find it rolled away, the cloth folded and your own name spoken by the Gardener.
descriptions.THIM1012EN: Take the small gate, climb the switchbacks above the timberline, and follow the quiet road with little traffic home to Christ.
descriptions.THIM1013EN: One degree off can land you in the wrong valley: take your bearing from Christ each morning and be realigned, not replaced.
descriptions.THIM1014EN: No one stands taller at the foot of the Cross: thieves, soldiers and the man you wouldn't greet all share one loaf on level ground.
descriptions.THIM1015EN: A voice wears out but the tune does not: pass the old hymnbook and the tailgate songs to children who are not even born yet.
descriptions.THIM1016EN: Turn off the headlines and lift your eyes: God sits on the throne straight through the worst news, robed in majesty and never late.
descriptions.THIM1017EN: Your name isn't on the deed, and that's good news: bring every grief to the One who holds the whole earth and a homeland for you.
descriptions.THIM1018EN: No throne room, just a low table and a lifted cup: receive the blood-sealed promise that runs all the way to the wedding of the Lamb.
descriptions.THIM1019EN: Come at the empty noon hour you picked so no one would see, and find Jesus already waiting at the well with water that satisfies.
descriptions.THIM1020EN: Birth waters, rivers, rain and sea all point to Jesus, who fills you like a channel so His life can keep flowing through you.
descriptions.THIM1021EN: Feet first, heart loud, arms wide open: stop being careful and let gladness win before the God who made every bone in you.
descriptions.THIM1022EN: A fistful of ground and the breath of God: remember where you began, and rise like the clay that sat up and adored.
descriptions.THIM1023EN: You cannot see the summit from here: write it down, lace up, and let Jesus lead you slowly toward the top anyway.
descriptions.THIM1024EN: Watch the cloud comb the mauna and rain run down the ridge, then drink deep from Ke Akua, who set the slopes to catch water for you.
descriptions.THIM1025EN: The rock had the melody before you had a mouth: come in late to creation's song and find the Maker has saved room for your voice.
descriptions.THIM1026EN: Step for step and shoulder to shoulder, walk each morning with a Friend who takes whatever you've got and never gets ahead of you.
descriptions.THIM1027EN: Breathe easy: the Holy Spirit is no breeze that brushed past once, but the very air you get to live on today.
descriptions.THIM1028EN: Twice a day the water comes back right on time, and so does God's mercy, all the way up to the shore where you stand.
descriptions.THIM1028RO: Aloha from the cross rolls in wave after wave, washing a whole island family clean with mercy that never runs dry.
descriptions.THIM1029EN: The jail door swings open, the jailer gets free too, and your empty hands finally have room to rise in praise.
descriptions.THIM1030EN: Climb into the cloud with three fishermen, hear the Father say listen to Him, and walk back down with new eyes.
descriptions.THIM1031EN: Take the other end: faith that lifts on the count of three, carries a friend's mat and holds the light for a brother.
descriptions.THIM1032EN: After the casseroles stop and the bedside chair sits empty, find the steady stride that walks one more sunrise with Jesus.
descriptions.THIM1033EN: Out the door, down the steps, still praying: learn to talk with God all day long without ever breaking stride.
descriptions.THIM1034EN: Bring God the words you were given, not the ones you earned, and hear Him receive the whole song of your heart.
descriptions.THIM1035EN: Nobody gets left on the trail: twenty-two set out, twenty-two come home, and the Lord counts every one at the gate.
descriptions.THIM1036EN: March under the softest banner on the battlefield, a Lamb who let Himself be led and is the only One still standing.
descriptions.THIM1037EN: Before the first morning He was already glad, and that joy is big enough to hold every beginning and ending of yours.
descriptions.THIM1038EN: Gratitude out loud and line by line, naming every gift to Jesus until somebody finally has to tell you to sit down.
descriptions.THIM1039EN: Where life split in two, He puts His own hands in the break, makes peace with His blood, and the mend holds good.
descriptions.THIM1040EN: The Maker of everything stood in line for water with sunburn on His neck, and He still walks at your speed.
descriptions.THIM1040RO: From a stable to a rolled-away stone, meet the Lamb who walked dusty roads, touched the untouchable and walks with us still.
descriptions.THIM1041EN: Not a wall but a doorway: Jesus is narrow as a door and wide as whoever comes, and that door is never locked.
descriptions.THIM1042EN: Drop His hand if you must, He already has your wrist, and that is a family hold nobody ever slips out of.
descriptions.THIM1043EN: Love is more than a warm wind down the lane: it wore a face, walked into the day and answers to the name Jesus.
descriptions.THIM1044EN: Gloves on, gate open: caring for God's land becomes worship you do with your hands, not a slogan on a truck.
descriptions.THIM1045EN: From the fern in the clouds to the last rock in the swell, trust a Provider who never skips a single corner of your life.
descriptions.THIM1046EN: Honest weights and a level hand: live clean before a Savior whose scale is truer than any market and whose price is paid.
descriptions.THIM1047EN: Three miles out is not too far to turn the truck around, so swallow the pride and drive back to make it right.
descriptions.THIM1048EN: Tūtū's old hymnbook and stories on the lānai: honor the elders who pointed you to Jesus with a Tuesday, not a card.
descriptions.THIM1049EN: It takes two notes to make a chord: many islands in one canoe, singing different parts to the same Son.
descriptions.THIM1050EN: Your name is on the line: step into the calling God handed you, faithful in the small things and ready to show up anyway.
descriptions.THIM1051EN: Swim past the reef where green turns to deep blue and rest in a love God made far too big for you to measure.
descriptions.THIM1052EN: The fan is already turning and nobody needs your story: pull up a chair where grace keeps room for everyone.
descriptions.THIM1053EN: Not a truce or a lucky year, but maluhia that stays when trouble walks in, because this peace is a Person beside you.
descriptions.THIM1054EN: Across the roar of the whole crowd, Jesus says your name out loud, not next, not whoever's over there, but you.
descriptions.THIM1055EN: Fingers tell the water, palms tell the stone, and a dancer's hands tell the story of Jesus clear to the back row.
descriptions.THIM1056EN: Healing the long way, a little every day: rest in a Savior who is gentle with your wounds and never in a hurry with you.
descriptions.THIM1056HI: A Hindi cry of Lapaʻau: bring body, mind and spirit to Jesus and ask Him to lay His hands on every weary place.
descriptions.THIM1057EN: Wherever you move, a gold road of light on the water runs straight to your feet, and the Light Himself comes to meet you.
descriptions.THIM1058EN: Three wraps and a hitch: when the storm pulls hard, Jesus is the cleat that holds your line, and the boat is still there at dawn.
descriptions.THIM1059EN: Worship with no translating in your head: a hymn in your own words, where the meaning lands first and your whole chest sings.
descriptions.THIM1060EN: Not almost, not one more mile: the door closes behind you, His hands rest on your shoulders, and you are finally home.
descriptions.TTX301: Waddle, slide and sing along with Penguino as little ones learn that Jesus loves their waddle and wraps them up like a cozy coat.
descriptions.TTX302: Wagging tails, puddle dances and puppy prayers help kids discover that Jesus is the best friend who always calls them home.
descriptions.TTX303: Salsa spins, fiesta popcorn and a giggly no coffee for Fluffy teach children to share, forgive and shout gracias to God.
descriptions.TTX304: Carrot rockets, marshmallow tails and a sneezing bunny choir keep kids hopping and praising, then wiggle them gently into peace.
descriptions.TTX305: Grab a pretend microphone: cuddles, pajama parades and a Sabbath snuggle turn family karaoke night into happy praise.
descriptions.TTX306: Bubble-lujah under the sea: jellyfish hair, tangled tubas and glowfish spotlights teach kids kindness and never swimming alone.
descriptions.TTX307: Socks on ears, just one cookie and a sorry to the cactus: giggly llama lessons in patience, sharing and walking with God.
descriptions.TTX308: Slow down with God by the tide pool, where little ones learn to be kind even to crabs, forgive and build again.
descriptions.TTX309: Nightlight on, stuffies snuggled, no fear in here: a cozy bedtime where children lay down the day and trust God's moonlight.
descriptions.TTX310: Prickles and all, little dancers can stomp a happy polka and celebrate the God who lovingly made every single quill.
descriptions.TTX311: Rest is a gift: drip-drop peace, soft songs and the shelter of His wings ease busy little hearts toward safe and sound sleep.
descriptions.TTX312: From crayons and creation to pajama prayers, a playful platypus day teaches kids to hop, stop, listen and dream big safe in God.
descriptions.TTX313: Clap like an otter, float in kindness and send up bubble prayers, splashing into a big love that jumps along with your child.
descriptions.TTX314: Stretch tall and look up: giraffe-sized neck hugs and jungle grooves show children that God is near, high as the sky.
descriptions.TTX315: A duckling lost in the reeds and found again teaches kids, between quackin' hallelujahs, that Jesus rides in their boat.
descriptions.TTX316: Clap-clap flippers and bubbles of joy teach little swimmers not to fear the storm, because Jesus swims right beside them.
descriptions.TTX317: Stripes, tiger tails and hide-and-seek with God celebrate how every child is made different and loved bigger than the sky.
descriptions.TTX318: Glowy hearts, peekaboo with Jesus and angels tucking them in: a moonlit dance party that ends in sweet, safe sleep.
descriptions.TTX319: Bouncer the Brave shows little paws how to help, be kind and say hello to God, knowing they are special and never alone.
descriptions.TTX320: Patience is power: slow and steady steps teach kids God's timing, the fruit of the Spirit and shining for Jesus at their own pace.
descriptions.TTX321: Clip-clop, bray for joy and let God hold the reins as little drummers learn kindness and how to forgive and trot on.
descriptions.TTX322: Beach-day giggles, dolphin dances and bubble prayers that always rise make Jesus a best friend by the sea.
descriptions.TTX323: Wiggles, gobble-gobble thank-yous and an oopsie God still loves remind every child they can pray anytime and shine from inside.
descriptions.TTX324: Hammer, hug and help: a busy builder chews the dock, says sorry and drums away the scary, knowing wherever he goes, God goes.
descriptions.TTX325: Follow the fireflies to a gentle jungle lullaby, where spotted cubs learn forgiveness and lift a prayer paw before sleep.
descriptions.TTX326: Share the jellybeans, say sorry and wiggle under God's big umbrella, where every little one is wonderfully made.
descriptions.TTX327: God made the wiggle worms too: bright giggles teach tiny ones they are marvelous, need not worry and are loved after any oops.
descriptions.TTX328: Bear hugs, shared honey and a blessing fort carry little cubs from roaring praise all the way to a soft goodnight to God.
descriptions.TTX329: Soggy underpants, a whoopee-cushion choir and a bubble bath catastrophe prove to giggling kids that Jesus loves stinky too.
descriptions.TTX330: Big God, little me: brave bubble faith for scary moments and a firefly glow that lets kids know they can talk to Jesus anytime.
descriptions.TTX331: Mudslide mercy and peace over panic: splash-happy hippos teach kids to link arms, wait patiently and know they are forgiven.
descriptions.TTX332: Count seeds, dance in sunshine and flap friendship wings as a tiny ladybug learns healthy habits and grows in God's garden.
descriptions.ZEIM1001EN: Where old quarrels echo and walls divide, cross the bridge Yeshua built and meet the stranger as family on the same holy ground.
descriptions.ZEIM1002EN: Ancient cantillation marks come alive until every letter of the scroll sings Yeshua's name, and your own mouth becomes the scroll.
descriptions.ZEIM1003EN: Throw open Yahuah's calendar and dance from Pesach freedom to Sukkot booths, carrying seven holy parties into an ordinary Monday.
descriptions.ZEIM1004EN: Hammond organ meets the shofar as Nehemiah's wall goes back up and upper-room fire wakes a Body remembering her own roots.
descriptions.ZEIM1005EN: Not by might, not by power: strike the match, watch the oil keep holding, and pass a burning faith into your children's hands.
descriptions.ZEIM1006EN: Nachamu, nachamu: feel the Shepherd carry you like a lamb inside His cloak, then turn and sit with the next one weeping.
descriptions.ZEIM1007EN: Boaz on the threshing floor, Job's living Redeemer, chains dropped in the sand: the price is paid, so dance.
descriptions.ZEIM1008EN: Light the candles, bless the cup and let Friday sunset settle over your table, carrying Sabbath-sized peace into a busy week.
descriptions.ZEIM1009EN: Hear the broken shevarim blasts mend what is shattered, and rise like a watchman as the great horn wakes the camp to follow Him.
descriptions.ZEIM1010EN: Psalms 23, 27, 46 and 139 climb off the page and onto their feet, giving you words for fear, stillness and joy that stand up.
descriptions.ZEIM1011EN: Stand up from the pig pen and take the first step down that dusty road, because the Father runs to you with a robe and a ring.
descriptions.ZEIM1012EN: All aboard, from lamb's blood on the door to a booth on the roof: a joyful ride through every feast pointing to the risen Messiah.
descriptions.ZEIM1013EN: Six million names are kept in heaven's book: grieve honestly, then hear the dry bones stand and every tear be wiped away.
descriptions.ZEIM1014EN: Baruch HaBa: lift the gates and watch the Kingdom walk through your own front door, every knee bowing to the Lamb with the crown.
descriptions.ZEIM1015EN: The priestly blessing falls like a river of grace, His face shining on you, until you carry it out your door to the next person.
descriptions.ZEIM1015HE: Hear the blessing of Numbers 6 sung in its own Hebrew, and let His shining face and keeping hand rest on every road you walk.
descriptions.ZEIM1016EN: Step into the Jordan in Joshua's sandals and pitch your tent on the promise, discovering the inheritance was Yeshua all along.
descriptions.ZEIM1017EN: What you thought was a rulebook turns out to be a wedding song, as hearts of stone become flesh and the Shema fills your mouth.
descriptions.ZEIM1018EN: From Abraham walking between the pieces to blood on the doorpost, meet a hesed that won't quit, signed in Yeshua's blood.
descriptions.ZEIM1019EN: Tamar, Ruth, David the eighth son and Mary's quiet yes: trace the mercy-filled family tree God used to bring the Savior home.
descriptions.ZEIM1020EN: Kol shem shar: every name from Avraham to Yosef the carpenter sings in folk colours, and your tangled story finds its place too.
descriptions.ZEIM1021EN: Walk into the garden before sunrise and find the stone rolled off the tomb and off your heart, with a highway through the sand.
descriptions.ZEIM1021RO: The risen sun climbs over a Romanian garden tomb, rolling the weight off your heart and sending you home under resurrection light.
descriptions.ZEIM1022EN: Leap before the ark like David and feel the covenant floor hold firm beneath you, even on the day the music stopped.
descriptions.ZEIM1022RO: When the music stops, the floor still holds: a Romanian street dance for covenant love that chases you through every generation.
descriptions.ZEIM1023EN: Leave home like Avraham, wrestle through the night like Ya'akov, and find the same faithful God pitching His tent beside yours.
descriptions.ZEIM1024EN: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem with morning on the Galilee, grafted into one olive tree whose covenant roots still hold you.
descriptions.ZEIM1025EN: Hear, O Israel, from the mezuzah on the doorpost to the Shema whispered at bedtime: love the One God with all your strength.
descriptions.ZEIM1025HE: Sung wholly in Hebrew, the Shema moves from doorpost to bedside, drawing heart, soul and strength toward one undivided Name.
descriptions.ZEIM1025HI: Harmonium, tabla and sitar wrap the ancient Shema in Hindi devotion, drawing your whole heart to the One undivided Name.
descriptions.ZEIM1026EN: Set your days by heaven's appointed times and let each holy feast light a fresh fire of worship in your calendar and your heart.
descriptions.ZEIM1027EN: Clear the week off the table and light the candles, as Erev Shabbat turns your home into a set-apart place where rest wins.
descriptions.ZEIM1028EN: Let the Spirit sing peace over the worry, the house and the whole unfinished day, until Yahuah's shalom covers every corner.
descriptions.ZEIM1029EN: Make His Word your morning song and your night light, a sweet and steady rhythm that keeps your heart glad from dawn to dusk.
descriptions.ZEIM1030EN: Once an outsider, now a branch: feel mercy take you by the limb and graft you into a mishpacha where your song truly belongs.
descriptions.ZEIM1031EN: Lift your head toward golden gates with Psalm 122 gladness, and taste the hope of a city where every road leads home to Yahuah.
descriptions.ZEIM1032EN: Ki l'olam chasdo: rest in a mercy that has held on through every season and will not loosen its grip on you, not ever.
descriptions.ZEIM1033EN: Mark the doorpost and hear death pass over, as the Passover Lamb covers what was raw and walks you out free at last.
descriptions.ZEIM1034EN: Guitars roar as every name you have answered to bows beneath the Name above all names, and you find who you truly are in Yeshua.
descriptions.ZEIM1035EN: East, west, north and south, the scattered are coming home, and there is a seat for you in the packed house of Yahuah.
descriptions.ZEIM1036EN: Pulsing beats invite sons and daughters to dance with all their might like David, trading self-consciousness for bold worship.
descriptions.ZEIM1037EN: Maranatha over a hip-hop beat: look up at the eastern sky and live today ready, hopeful and awake for the Messiah's return.
descriptions.ZEIM1038EN: Drop your bucket into the wells of salvation and come up with joy, drinking from Yeshua's cup when your own soul runs dry.
descriptions.ZEIM1039EN: L'dor vador: gather the kids at the table and on the road to pass down God's mighty works, so the chain of faith holds strong.
descriptions.ZEIM1040EN: Or LaGoyim with the volume up: carry the lamp of Israel and the Light of Yeshua into your streets, bright for every nation.
descriptions.ZHIM1001EN: Dry bones, wake up: steelpan and Hammond fire, Granny's tarry-room prayer and a Spirit strong enough to raise a whole army.
descriptions.ZHIM1002EN: Talking drums at dawn, Mama's kitchen praise and a Lagos tarmac vigil: dance into the joy that is your inheritance in Christ.
descriptions.ZHIM1003EN: Stand on the shoulders of praying grandmothers who waded through the water, and run on with the same God they trusted.
descriptions.ZHIM1004EN: Put on the mind of Christ to a shuffling beat, from panyard prayer meetings to hurricane faith that hears Him say peace, be still.
descriptions.ZHIM1005EN: Wave the white flag on the Carnival road, then let steelpan, B3 organ and Granny's kitchen prayer carry you into loud, free praise.
descriptions.ZHIM1006EN: He pulled you off the floor: Kingston bass, broken chains and a new name on the riddim for everyone the Father ran to meet.
descriptions.ZHIM1007EN: Hear Mama praying through the wall and Grandmother's prayer crossing the sea, a three-strand cord that holds your household.
descriptions.ZHIM1008EN: Lift your crown in the mirror, sister: from a Lagos sunrise into your own calling, you are seated, standing and sent in Christ.
descriptions.ZHIM1009EN: The power that raised Jesus turns mourning into dancing and lifts dry bones into a standing army, starting with you.
descriptions.ZHIM1010EN: Though the fig tree does not blossom, rejoice anyway: tanbou drums, Mama's Sunday stories and joy that comes in the morning.
descriptions.ZHIM1011EN: Scattered far from home, you are still found: the Good Shepherd binds up the broken and gathers every one of His own by name.
descriptions.ZHIM1012EN: Stomp in and enter His gates with thanksgiving: Auntie's Sunday soup, a Pentecost praise break and joy that becomes strength.
descriptions.ZHIM1013EN: Rain on the tin roof, a reef cathedral and a fisherman's covenant: deep truth about God, preached in the language of the islands.
descriptions.ZHIM1014EN: They took the names but never the faith: from the ship's hold to the throne, see God turn what was meant for evil into good.
descriptions.ZHIM1015EN: Lift your hands and your voice: worship that hears the widow's cry and lets justice roll down like water, walking in mercy.
descriptions.ZHIM1016EN: Run with Mary to the garden, find the stone rolled away, then rise on a one-drop groove to walk in brand-new life.
descriptions.ZHIM1017EN: Mercy is the revolution: Jesus builds a table, grows gardens in the ruins and sings the burnt-out to sleep, so lay it all down.
descriptions.ZHIM1018EN: Grandmother's prayers never died: plant yourself deeper, walk in your name and watch the family altar light up again.
descriptions.ZHIM1018HI: Drums call the ancestors' names and a grandmother's prayer holds fast, planting you deep like a tree that is still standing.
descriptions.ZHIM1019EN: Grab the tambourine like Miriam and dance like David, because the joy of the Lord is a weapon no storm can steal from you.
descriptions.ZHIM1020EN: Pull up a chair in Granny's kitchen, where wash-day wisdom and porch-side lessons hand you a faith that knows the Bible by heart.
descriptions.ZHIM1021EN: From Deborah's courage to Mary running from the empty tomb, hear heaven call every daughter to stand up and wear her strength.
descriptions.ZHIM1022EN: Pull out your receipts: every storm He carried you through is fresh proof the same God will come through again.
descriptions.ZHIM1023EN: The attack did not win: climb out of the pit shouting, with the devil under your feet and a love that will not let you go.
descriptions.ZHIM1023RO: Biruință in every beat: rise from the pit in Romanian praise, sure that nothing in heaven or earth can pry you from His love.
descriptions.ZHIM1024EN: He came looking and found you on the floor, then pulled out a chair at His table for a wanderer who never earned a seat.
descriptions.ZHIM1025EN: Join the mass choir and the morning stars in handing all the glory back to the Lamb, the only Name worthy of every shout.
descriptions.ZHIM1026EN: Turn around and see the pit you climbed out of, then plant your feet on the rock and praise Him for the whole road home.
descriptions.ZHIM1027EN: A midnight jail in Philippi, fifteen years of dragging the same chain, and one Name that makes it snap: walk out free.
descriptions.ZHIM1028EN: When the Red Sea blocks your road and the bills pile up, stand still and watch the east wind blow all night on your behalf.
descriptions.ZHIM1029EN: Wade into Bethesda's waters with a great-grandmother's hands on your shoulder and find the Balm in Gilead for your broken places.
descriptions.ZHIM1030EN: Keep the night watch through your tears until a streak of gray in the east and the first bird singing tell you daybreak has come.
descriptions.ZHIM1030RO: Sorrow gets one night; Bucuria gets the morning, as a Romanian dawn choir rises over your tears with mercies made new.
descriptions.ZHIM1031EN: Look over your shoulder: goodness and mercy are chasing you on a reggae one-drop, from Tuesday's small mercies to a lighthouse.
descriptions.ZHIM1032EN: The hymn she hummed at the kitchen sink becomes the song of three generations, and a faith you can hand down to your own children.
descriptions.ZHIM1033EN: Auntie's knees on the linoleum, a hot plate in the kitchen: feel the prayers of women who never let go of your name hold you up.
descriptions.ZHIM1034EN: Choir robes, a deacon's prayer, fellowship hall coffee and an altar rail at dawn: come back to the pew, the doors are open.
descriptions.ZHIM1035EN: From an empty cupboard in Lagos to tuition paid in Atlanta, meet the Provider who shows up right on time, wherever life lands you.
descriptions.ZHIM1036EN: Keep praying through year fifteen, smooth and unhurried, because the delay was preparation and the answer is already walking in.
descriptions.ZHIM1037EN: Lace up for day 1847 of the grind: a friend runs beside you, eagle wings lift you, and your strength is renewed for the next mile.
descriptions.ZHIM1038EN: Open your hands at the altar rail like Mary breaking her alabaster jar, and find the rest that comes with praying, not my will.
descriptions.ZHIM1039EN: Old hymns and a communion cup lead you back to Calvary's fountain, where the blood that saved the saints still washes you clean.
descriptions.ZHIM1040EN: Sunday-morning highlife guitars dance sorrow off the floor, proving the joy of the Lord is a strength that bends but never breaks.
descriptions.ZHIM1041EN: Adopted, betrothed and wonderfully made, hear the Father call you His own and carry a new name no one can ever take away.
descriptions.ARMADILLOS: Pack the snacks and buckle up the kids for a bumpy, rolling road trip that turns backseat boredom into giggles.
descriptions.BEARS: Chilly toes, warm hearts: little ones can shimmy through a snowy igloo dance party that melts every frown.
descriptions.CHAMELEONS: Every beat is a brand-new colour: let your child shake, spin and giggle through a rainbow-bright party.
descriptions.CHEETAHS: Ready, set, zoom: fast feet and spinning fun help little racers burn off every last wiggle before naptime.
descriptions.CLAW: Step right up to a snappy carnival where kids can clap, cheer and dance their way through a day of funfair joy.
descriptions.CONSCIOUSNESS: Wake slow in the half-light, where old lies fall away like night and the still small voice meets you as gently as dawn.
descriptions.FERRETS: Duck low, wriggle through and pop out giggling: a burrow of bouncy fun for curious little explorers.
descriptions.FROG: Hop, croak and splash along: a lily-pad party that gets toddlers leaping, laughing and joining in.
descriptions.HYENAS: Giggles are contagious here: turn it up and watch the whole family catch the silliest case of the laughs.
descriptions.IGUANAS: Turn the living room into a sandy island dance floor and watch little faces light up with every wiggle.
descriptions.OSTRICHS: Long legs, big feathers, bigger grins: a dash-around dance that burns off the wiggles and fills the house with laughter.
descriptions.PARTY: Grab a friend and make some happy noise: a lighthearted celebration made for dancing, laughing and sharing good gifts together.
descriptions.RHINOS: Stomp, stamp and rumble like a friendly rhino, happy thunder that gets every small foot in the house moving.
descriptions.STARFISHS: Slip beneath the waves to a coral hideaway where little listeners can sway, twirl and shine like tiny stars.
descriptions.STINGRAYS: Glide and flutter through a bright reef dance party that turns a wriggly afternoon into pure underwater fun.
descriptions.TRACKS: Faith-rooted music for the moments you need to lean on God and find your footing again.
descriptions.VOL: Walk with Matthew from Joseph's silent yes and the magi's star to the Jordan, the desert and the hill where Jesus blesses the poor.
descriptions.WOLFS: The wolf is throwing the party and everyone is invited, so bring your friends, your giggles and your silliest dance moves.
